summary.zh-Hant: 六爻全陽：上下兩半都是乾，整卦沒有一條斷線。
summary.en: Six yang lines: both halves are Qian, and not one line is broken.

objectives.zh-Hant: 認出六爻全陽的卦就是乾。
objectives.en: Recognise that the hexagram of six yang lines is Qian.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼乾的上下卦交換之後還是乾。
objectives.en: Explain why swapping the halves of Qian still gives Qian.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出把乾的初爻翻面會得到姤。
objectives.en: Work out that The Creative with its first line flipped is Encountering.

structure.zh-Hant: 乾由兩個乾疊成：下半三爻都是實線，上半三爻也都是實線。由下往上數，六爻無一例外都是陽。因為上下兩半一模一樣，交換位置看不出差別，所以乾這一卦要改用「翻面一爻」來觀察。
structure.en: Qian is Qian stacked on Qian: the lower three lines are solid and so are the upper three. Counting from the bottom, every one of the six lines is yang. Because the two halves are identical, swapping them changes nothing, so with Qian we observe by flipping a single line instead.

plain.zh-Hant: 乾代表天，也代表往前推、往上走的那股力量。整卦六爻全陽，講的是力量最完整、最沒有阻隔的狀態。要注意的是，它描述的是結構，不是保證：六爻全陽只說明「沒有一處是收斂的」，不說明結果一定好。傳統上乾後面接著很多提醒，正是因為純粹的推力容易過頭。
plain.en: Qian stands for heaven, and for the force that pushes forward and upward. With all six lines yang, it pictures force at its most complete and least obstructed. Note that this describes a structure, not a promise: six yang lines only say that nothing here is holding back; they do not say the outcome will be good. Tradition attaches many cautions to Qian precisely because unmixed drive overreaches easily.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個剛拿到資源、所有人都點頭的新專案，條件上沒有任何一處卡住。乾描述的就是這種「處處都通」的結構，它不告訴你這個專案會不會成功，只告訴你現在沒有任何東西在替你踩煞車。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a new project that has just been funded and has everyone's agreement, with nothing in its conditions blocking it. Qian describes exactly that kind of unobstructed structure. It does not tell you whether the project will succeed; it tells you that nothing is currently applying the brakes for you.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把最下面那一爻翻成陰，看看卦名與上下卦怎麼變。這是一爻翻面，不是整組三爻換位置。
instruction.en: Flip the bottom line to yin and watch the name and the two halves change. This is one line flipping, not a whole trigram moving.

prompt.zh-Hant: 乾的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Qian?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。上面三爻都是實線，那就是乾；下面三爻也是乾。
explanation.en: Correct. The upper three lines are all solid, which is Qian — and so is the lower half.

explanation.zh-Hant: 坤是三條斷線。乾這一卦沒有任何一條斷線。
explanation.en: Kun is three broken lines. Qian has no broken line anywhere.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌最上面那一爻是斷的。乾的第六爻是實線。
explanation.en: Dui has a broken top line. The sixth line of Qian is solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把乾的上下卦交換，會得到什麼？
prompt.en: Swap the two halves of Qian. What do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。上下兩半都是乾，換過去換過來都一樣，所以乾不適合用交換來觀察。
explanation.en: Correct. Both halves are Qian, so swapping them leaves the figure unchanged; that is why Qian is not observed by swapping.

explanation.zh-Hant: 交換位置不會把陽爻變成陰爻。要得到坤，六爻都得翻面。
explanation.en: Swapping positions does not turn yang lines into yin. Getting Kun would require flipping all six lines.

explanation.zh-Hant: 姤是乾的初爻翻成陰之後的樣子，那是翻面，不是交換。
explanation.en: Gou is what you get when the bottom line of Qian flips to yin — that is flipping, not swapping.

prompt.zh-Hant: 乾的初爻翻成陰，會變成哪一卦？
prompt.en: The bottom line of Qian flips to yin. Which hexagram results?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦從乾變成巽，上卦還是乾，那是第 44 卦姤。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower trigram becomes Xun while the upper stays Qian, which is hexagram 44, Gou.

explanation.zh-Hant: 履是下兌上乾，斷的是下卦最上面那一爻，不是最下面那一爻。
explanation.en: Lü is Dui below Qian; its broken line is the top line of the lower trigram, not the bottom one.

explanation.zh-Hant: 同人斷的是第二爻。爻一律由下往上數，初爻是最下面那一條。
explanation.en: Tong Ren has its second line broken. Lines are counted from the bottom, so the first line is the lowest one.

summary.zh-Hant: 六爻全陰：上下兩半都是坤，整卦沒有一條實線。
summary.en: Six yin lines: both halves are Kun, and not one line is solid.

objectives.zh-Hant: 認出六爻全陰的卦就是坤。
objectives.en: Recognise that the hexagram of six yin lines is Kun.

objectives.zh-Hant: 講清楚坤與乾的結構關係。
objectives.en: State how Kun and Qian are related structurally.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出坤的初爻翻面之後會變成復。
objectives.en: Say that flipping the first line of The Receptive gives Returning.

structure.zh-Hant: 坤由兩個坤疊成：下半三爻都是斷線，上半三爻也都是斷線。它和乾是逐爻相反——乾的每一爻是實線，坤的同一位置就是斷線。上下兩半相同，所以坤也要用「翻面一爻」來觀察。
structure.en: Kun is Kun stacked on Kun: the lower three lines are broken and so are the upper three. It is the line-by-line opposite of Qian — wherever Qian has a solid line, Kun has a broken one. Its two halves are identical, so Kun too is observed by flipping a single line.

plain.zh-Hant: 坤代表地，也代表承載、容納、順著走的那一面。六爻全陰不是「什麼都沒有」，而是整卦都在描述承受與配合的結構。它常被講成被動，但更準確的說法是：力量不在發動的那一端，而在接住的那一端。接不住，發動也沒有用。
plain.en: Kun stands for earth, and for carrying, holding and going along with things. Six yin lines do not mean emptiness; the whole hexagram describes a structure of receiving and accommodating. It is often called passive, but a more accurate reading is that the force here sits at the receiving end rather than the initiating one. Without something to receive it, initiating force goes nowhere.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊裡負責承接的人：需求來了就安排、資源到了就分配，自己不提新方向。坤描述的是這個位置的結構，不是說這種人比較差，也不是說這個團隊會怎麼發展。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: the person on a team who absorbs whatever arrives: requests get scheduled, resources get allocated, and they propose no new direction of their own. Kun describes the structure of that position. It does not say such a person is lesser, nor does it say how the team will fare.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把最下面那一爻翻成陽，看看卦名怎麼變。只有這一爻動，其餘五爻不動。
instruction.en: Flip the bottom line to yang and watch the name change. Only that line moves; the other five stay put.

prompt.zh-Hant: 坤和乾的關係是什麼？
prompt.en: How is Kun related to Qian?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。乾六爻全陽、坤六爻全陰，同一個位置的陰陽剛好對調。
explanation.en: Correct. Qian is six yang lines and Kun is six yin; at every position the line type is reversed.

explanation.zh-Hant: 交換上下卦不會改變任何一爻的陰陽。坤和乾差的是陰陽，不是位置。
explanation.en: Swapping halves changes no line's type. Kun differs from Qian in line type, not position.

text.en: They differ only in the top line

explanation.zh-Hant: 只差一爻的是夬。坤和乾六爻全都不同。
explanation.en: Differing by one line would be Guai. Kun differs from Qian in all six lines.

prompt.zh-Hant: 坤的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Kun?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下面三爻都是斷線，那就是坤；上面三爻也是坤。
explanation.en: Correct. The bottom three lines are all broken, which is Kun — and so is the upper half.

text.en: Gen (two broken below, one solid on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 艮最上面那一爻是實線。坤整卦沒有實線。
explanation.en: Gen has a solid top line. Kun has no solid line at all.

explanation.zh-Hant: 坎的中間那一爻是實的。坤的第二爻是斷線。
explanation.en: Kan has a solid middle line. The second line of Kun is broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 坤的初爻翻成陽，會變成哪一卦？
prompt.en: The bottom line of Kun flips to yang. Which hexagram results?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦從坤變成震，上卦還是坤，那是第 24 卦復。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower trigram becomes Zhen while the upper stays Kun, which is hexagram 24, Fu.

explanation.zh-Hant: 謙實的那一爻在第三位，下卦是艮。初爻是最下面那一條。
explanation.en: In Qian (Modesty) the solid line is in the third position, making the lower trigram Gen. The first line is the lowest one.

explanation.zh-Hant: 師實的那一爻在第二位，下卦是坎。
explanation.en: In Shi the solid line sits in the second position, making the lower trigram Kan.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坎下震：動在下、險在上，開頭最難的那個結構。
summary.en: Kan above, Zhen below: movement underneath, danger on top — the structure of a hard beginning.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出屯的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Zhun.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出「動在下、險在上」怎麼讀出開頭的難處。
objectives.en: Explain how movement below and danger above reads as a difficult start.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，屯會變成解。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns Difficult Beginning into Release.

structure.zh-Hant: 屯的下卦是震：一陽在最下，上面兩爻是陰。上卦是坎：中間一陽，上下兩爻是陰。由下往上讀，整卦是先動起來，隨即遇到坎。兩個三爻卦都只有一條實線，位置不同，意思就完全不同。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Zhun is Zhen: one yang at the bottom with two yin above it. The upper is Kan: one yang in the middle with yin on both sides. Read from the bottom up, the figure moves first and immediately runs into Kan. Both trigrams have just one solid line; their different positions make their meanings entirely different.

plain.zh-Hant: 震是動、是剛起步的那一下；坎是坑、是陷住。屯把動放在下面、險放在上面，描述的是「已經出發，但前面還沒清出路」。它常被講成萬事起頭難，但更貼近結構的說法是：這個階段不缺動力，缺的是方向與落腳處。
plain.en: Zhen is movement, the first stirring; Kan is a pit, being caught. Zhun puts movement below and danger above, picturing a situation that has already set off before the road ahead has been cleared. It is often glossed as “beginnings are hard”, but closer to the structure is this: at this stage drive is not what is missing — direction and a foothold are.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊已經開始動工，但規格還沒定、權責還沒分。力氣用得出去，卻常常撞牆。屯描述的是這個結構，不是說這件事注定失敗。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a team has started building, but the specification is unsettled and responsibilities are undivided. Effort goes out and keeps hitting walls. Zhun describes that structure; it does not say the work is doomed.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：震移到上面、坎移到下面，看看變成哪一卦。整組三爻搬位置，沒有任何一爻翻面。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Zhen moves up and Kan moves down, and see which hexagram appears. Whole trigrams move; no line flips.

prompt.zh-Hant: 屯的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Zhun?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻斷、第五爻實、第六爻斷，那是坎。
explanation.en: Correct. The fourth line is broken, the fifth solid and the sixth broken: that is Kan.

text.en: Zhen (one solid below, two broken above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 震在屯裡是下卦。由下往上數，實線在初爻的是震。
explanation.en: In Zhun, Zhen is the lower trigram; its solid line sits in the first position.

explanation.zh-Hant: 坤三爻全斷。屯的第五爻是實線。
explanation.en: Kun is all broken. The fifth line of Zhun is solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「動在下、險在上」在屯裡指的是什麼？
prompt.en: What do “movement below, danger above” refer to in Zhun?

text.zh-Hant: 下卦震是動，上卦坎是險
text.en: The lower Zhen is movement and the upper Kan is danger

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。讀卦由下往上，所以先是震的動，接著才遇到坎。
explanation.en: Correct. Hexagrams read from the bottom up, so Zhen's movement comes first and then meets Kan.

text.zh-Hant: 上卦震是動，下卦坎是險
text.en: The upper Zhen is movement and the lower Kan is danger

explanation.zh-Hant: 位置記反了。屯是下震上坎，交換之後才是下坎上震，那是解。
explanation.en: The positions are reversed. Zhun is Zhen below Kan; the other arrangement is Jie.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩個都是坎才是坎卦（第 29 卦）。屯只有上卦是坎。
explanation.en: Two Kan trigrams would be hexagram 29, Kan itself. In Zhun only the upper half is Kan.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把屯的上下卦交換，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Swap the halves of Zhun. Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下坎上震是第 40 卦解，和屯剛好是同樣兩個三爻卦調個位置。
explanation.en: Correct. Kan below Zhen is hexagram 40, Xie — the same two trigrams with their positions exchanged.

explanation.zh-Hant: 蒙是下坎上艮，上卦不是震。
explanation.en: Meng is Kan below Gen; its upper trigram is not Zhen.

explanation.zh-Hant: 需是下乾上坎，下卦不是坎。
explanation.en: Xu is Qian below Kan; its lower trigram is not Kan.

summary.zh-Hant: 上艮下坎：險在下、止在上，什麼都還沒看清楚的結構。
summary.en: Gen above, Kan below: danger underneath, stopping on top — nothing yet seen clearly.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出蒙的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Meng.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼「險在下、止在上」讀成未明。
objectives.en: Explain why danger below and stopping above reads as not yet clear.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出蒙的上下卦交換之後是蹇。
objectives.en: Work out that Youthful Ignorance with its halves swapped is Obstruction.

structure.zh-Hant: 蒙的下卦是坎：中間一陽，上下兩爻是陰。上卦是艮：最上面一陽，下面兩爻是陰。整卦只有第二爻與第六爻是實線。由下往上讀，先是坎的陷，再被艮擋住。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Meng is Kan: one yang in the middle with yin on either side. The upper is Gen: one yang at the very top with two yin beneath. Only the second and sixth lines of the figure are solid. Read upward, the pit of Kan comes first and is then stopped by Gen.

plain.zh-Hant: 坎是陷、是看不清；艮是停、是擋住。蒙把看不清放在下面、擋住放在上面，描述的是「身在局中，又沒有路看出去」。傳統上用它談啟蒙與教學，原因就在這個結構：要先有人把上面那道牆打開，裡面的人才看得見。
plain.en: Kan is a pit, a lack of clear sight; Gen is stopping, a blockage. Meng puts the unclear below and the blockage above, picturing someone inside a situation with no line of sight out of it. Tradition uses this hexagram to talk about teaching, and the structure is why: someone has to open the wall above before the person inside can see.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：新進的人被丟進一個沒有文件的系統裡，問題問不出口，因為連要問什麼都不知道。蒙描述的是這種結構，不是說這個人學不會。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a newcomer is dropped into an undocumented system and cannot even form a question, because they do not yet know what to ask. Meng describes that structure; it does not say the person cannot learn.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：坎移到上面、艮移到下面，看看卦名與圖怎麼一起變。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Kan moves up and Gen moves down, and watch the figure and the name change together.

prompt.zh-Hant: 蒙裡哪兩爻是實線？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Meng are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦坎的實線在第二爻，上卦艮的實線在第六爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The solid line of the lower Kan is the second, and that of the upper Gen is the sixth.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那會是下震上震的樣子。蒙的初爻是斷線。
explanation.en: That would be Zhen below Zhen. The first line of Meng is broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那是另一種組合。蒙的第三爻與第五爻都是斷線。
explanation.en: That is a different figure. In Meng the third and fifth lines are both broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 蒙的上卦艮在結構上做了什麼？
prompt.en: What does the upper trigram Gen do in Meng?

text.zh-Hant: 把上面擋住，所以看不出去
text.en: It blocks the top, so there is no view out

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。艮是止，擺在上卦就是把出口蓋住。
explanation.en: Correct. Gen is stopping; placed above, it covers the way out.

explanation.zh-Hant: 製造陷落的是下卦坎。艮在上卦。
explanation.en: The pit below is the lower trigram Kan. Gen is the upper one.

text.en: It sets the figure in motion

explanation.zh-Hant: 動是震的事，蒙裡沒有震。
explanation.en: Movement belongs to Zhen, and Meng contains no Zhen.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把蒙的上下卦交換，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Swap the halves of Meng. Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下艮上坎是第 39 卦蹇。
explanation.en: Correct. Gen below Kan is hexagram 39, Jian.

explanation.zh-Hant: 屯是下震上坎，下卦不是艮。
explanation.en: Zhun is Zhen below Kan; its lower trigram is not Gen.

explanation.zh-Hant: 剝是下坤上艮，下卦三爻全斷。
explanation.en: Bo is Kun below Gen, with three broken lines underneath.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坎下乾：推力在下、險在上，走到一半被攔住的結構。
summary.en: Kan above, Qian below: drive underneath, danger on top — stopped partway.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出需的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Xu.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼「乾在下、坎在上」讀成等待。
objectives.en: Explain why Qian below Kan reads as waiting.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出需與訟用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Waiting and Conflict use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 需的下卦是乾：三爻全陽。上卦是坎：中間一陽、上下兩爻是陰。由下往上讀，前三爻是飽滿的推力，到第四爻就進了坎。整卦的轉折點落在第四爻，那是上卦的第一爻。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Xu is Qian, three yang lines. The upper is Kan: one yang in the middle, yin on both sides. Read upward, the first three lines are full forward force, and at the fourth the figure enters Kan. The turn happens at the fourth line — the first line of the upper trigram.

plain.zh-Hant: 乾是往前，坎是險。需把推力放在下面、險放在上面，於是力量有、路沒有。這個結構被讀成等待，但等待不是停住不動：下卦的乾還在，該準備的仍然在準備，只是不往坎裡硬闖。要分清楚「等」和「放棄」。
plain.en: Qian pushes forward and Kan is danger. Xu puts the drive below and the danger above, so the force is there but the road is not. This structure is read as waiting — yet waiting is not standing still: the Qian below is still active, preparation continues, it simply does not charge into the pit. Waiting and giving up are not the same thing.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一份已經做好的提案，卡在對方尚未決定的時間表上。該備的資料繼續備，但不逼對方今天簽。需描述的是這個結構，不代表最後一定簽得成。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a finished proposal held up by the other side's undecided timetable. Preparation carries on, but nobody is pressed to sign today. Xu describes that structure; it does not mean the deal will close.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：乾移到上面、坎移到下面，看看變成哪一卦。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Qian moves up and Kan moves down, and see which hexagram appears.

prompt.zh-Hant: 需的轉折落在第幾爻？
prompt.en: At which line does Xu turn?

text.zh-Hant: 第四爻，上卦坎的第一爻
text.en: The fourth, the first line of the upper Kan

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。前三爻是乾，第四爻開始進入坎。
explanation.en: Correct. The first three lines are Qian; from the fourth the figure enters Kan.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第三爻還在下卦乾裡，是實線。
explanation.en: The third line is still inside the lower Qian and is solid.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第六爻是上卦的最後一爻，轉折在它之前就發生了。
explanation.en: The sixth is the last line of the upper trigram; the turn happens before it.

prompt.zh-Hant: 需被讀成等待，原因是什麼？
prompt.en: Why is Xu read as waiting?

text.zh-Hant: 下面有推力，上面有險，所以不硬闖
text.en: There is drive below and danger above, so one does not charge in

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。力量在、路不在，這個結構讀成等。
explanation.en: Correct. The force is present and the road is not; that structure reads as waiting.

text.zh-Hant: 六爻都是陰，什麼都不做
text.en: All six lines are yin, so nothing is done

explanation.zh-Hant: 六爻全陰是坤。需的下卦三爻全陽。
explanation.en: Six yin lines would be Kun. The lower half of Xu is three yang lines.

text.en: The halves are identical, so nothing can move

explanation.zh-Hant: 需的上下卦是坎與乾，並不相同。
explanation.en: The halves of Xu are Kan and Qian, which are not the same.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把需的上下卦交換，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Swap the halves of Xu. Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下坎上乾是第 6 卦訟，和需是同樣兩個三爻卦調個位置。
explanation.en: Correct. Kan below Qian is hexagram 6, Song — the same two trigrams with positions exchanged.

explanation.zh-Hant: 大有是下乾上離，上卦不是坎。
explanation.en: Da You is Qian below Li; its upper trigram is not Kan.

explanation.zh-Hant: 比是下坤上坎，下卦三爻全斷。
explanation.en: Bi is Kun below Kan, with three broken lines underneath.

summary.zh-Hant: 上乾下坎：險在下、剛在上，兩邊都不讓的結構。
summary.en: Qian above, Kan below: danger underneath, firmness on top — neither side yielding.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出訟的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Song.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出訟與需在結構上差在哪裡。
objectives.en: State how Song differs structurally from Xu.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，訟會變成需。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns Conflict into Waiting.

structure.zh-Hant: 訟的下卦是坎、上卦是乾，和需剛好對調。由下往上讀，先是坎的陷，再撞上乾那股不肯退的力量。整卦只有第二爻與上面三爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Song is Kan and the upper is Qian — exactly the reverse of Xu. Read upward, the pit of Kan comes first and then meets the unyielding force of Qian. Only the second line and the top three are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 同樣兩個三爻卦，位置一換，讀法就變了。需是力量在下、險在上，可以等；訟是險在下、硬在上，下面已經陷著，上面還不肯退，於是變成相持。傳統上把它讀成爭訟，重點不在誰對，而在這個結構本身很難靠加壓解決。
plain.en: The same two trigrams in the other order read quite differently. In Xu the force is below and the danger above, so waiting is possible. In Song the danger is below and the hardness above: the lower part is already stuck while the upper refuses to give way, and the result is deadlock. Tradition reads this as litigation — the point is not who is right, but that this structure is hard to resolve by applying more pressure.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：兩個部門為了同一筆預算各持立場，一邊已經卡住進度，另一邊堅持原本的分法。訟描述的是這種相持的結構，不預判誰會贏。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: two departments hold opposing positions on the same budget: one is already blocked, the other insists on the original split. Song describes that deadlocked structure; it does not predict who will win.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換，看看會回到哪一卦。同樣兩個三爻卦，位置一換，讀法就不一樣。
instruction.en: Swap the halves and see which hexagram you return to. The same two trigrams in the other order read differently.

prompt.zh-Hant: 訟和需的差別是什麼？
prompt.en: What is the difference between Song and Xu?

text.zh-Hant: 同樣的乾與坎，上下位置相反
text.en: The same Qian and Kan, with their positions reversed

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。訟是下坎上乾，需是下乾上坎。
explanation.en: Correct. Song is Kan below Qian; Xu is Qian below Kan.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦差的是整組三爻的位置，不是單爻翻面。
explanation.en: They differ by the position of whole trigrams, not by a single line flipping.

explanation.zh-Hant: 六爻全陽是乾。訟的下卦坎有兩條斷線。
explanation.en: Six yang lines would be Qian. The lower Kan of Song has two broken lines.

prompt.zh-Hant: 訟的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Song?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻斷、第二爻實、第三爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. The first line is broken, the second solid and the third broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 乾在訟裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Song, Qian is the upper trigram.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 巽的斷線在最下面。訟的下卦斷線在初爻與第三爻。
explanation.en: Xun has its broken line at the bottom. The lower trigram of Song is broken at the first and third lines.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼說訟這個結構不容易靠加壓解決？
prompt.en: Why is the structure of Song hard to resolve by pressure?

text.zh-Hant: 下面已經陷住，上面又不退
text.en: The lower part is already stuck and the upper will not yield

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。兩邊都沒有讓的餘地，加壓只是把相持拉長。
explanation.en: Correct. Neither side has room to give, so more pressure only prolongs the deadlock.

text.en: Because the figure has no yang lines

explanation.zh-Hant: 訟有四條實線，上卦整組都是陽。
explanation.en: Song has four solid lines; its whole upper trigram is yang.

explanation.zh-Hant: 訟的上下卦是乾與坎，不相同。
explanation.en: The halves of Song are Qian and Kan, which are not identical.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坤下坎：險在下、眾在上，要靠編制才帶得動的結構。
summary.en: Kun above, Kan below: danger underneath, the many on top — a structure that needs organisation.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出師的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Shi.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出師裡唯一的那條實線在第幾爻。
objectives.en: Say which line is the only solid one in Shi.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出師的上下卦交換之後是比。
objectives.en: Work out that The Army with its halves swapped is Holding Together.

structure.zh-Hant: 師的下卦是坎、上卦是坤。整卦只有第二爻是實線，其餘五爻都是斷線。那一條實線在下卦的中間，是整個結構唯一的著力點。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Shi is Kan and the upper is Kun. Only the second line is solid; the other five are broken. That single solid line sits in the middle of the lower trigram and is the one point of leverage in the whole figure.

plain.zh-Hant: 坤是眾、是地；坎是險。師把險放在下面、眾放在上面，講的是一大群人要在不安穩的地面上行動。整卦只有一條實線，所以重點不在人多，而在那個唯一的著力點能不能把眾人組織起來。傳統用軍隊來談它，說的就是編制的必要。
plain.en: Kun is the many, the ground; Kan is danger. Shi puts the danger below and the many above: a large group has to move over unstable ground. With only one solid line, the point is not numbers but whether that single point of leverage can organise the crowd. Tradition discusses it through armies, which is a way of saying that organisation is not optional.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個臨時成立的大型任務小組，人手夠但流程還沒定，只有一個人真的掌握全貌。師描述的是這種結構，不是說這個小組會完成任務。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a large task force assembled at short notice: there are enough people, no settled process, and only one person who really holds the whole picture. Shi describes that structure; it does not say the group will deliver.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：坎移到上面、坤移到下面，看看那條實線跑到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Kan moves up and Kun moves down, and see which position the solid line lands in.

prompt.zh-Hant: 師裡唯一的實線在第幾爻？
prompt.en: Which is the only solid line in Shi?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦坎的實線在中間，也就是整卦的第二爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The solid line of the lower Kan sits in its middle, which is the second line of the figure.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第五爻是上卦坤的中間，是斷線。實線在第五爻的是比。
explanation.en: The fifth line is the middle of the upper Kun and is broken. A solid fifth line would make Bi.

explanation.zh-Hant: 初爻是斷線。實線在初爻的是復。
explanation.en: The first line is broken. A solid first line would make Fu.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼說師的重點不在人多？
prompt.en: Why is the point of Shi not numbers?

text.zh-Hant: 整卦只有一條實線，著力點只有一個
text.en: The figure has only one solid line, so there is only one point of leverage

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。五條斷線加一條實線，力量集中在那一爻。
explanation.en: Correct. Five broken lines and one solid: the leverage is concentrated in that single line.

text.en: Because the upper trigram is Kan

explanation.zh-Hant: 師的上卦是坤，坎在下卦。
explanation.en: The upper trigram of Shi is Kun; Kan is below.

text.en: Because all six lines are yin

explanation.zh-Hant: 六爻全陰是坤。師有一條實線。
explanation.en: Six yin lines would be Kun. Shi has one solid line.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把師的上下卦交換，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Swap the halves of Shi. Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下坤上坎是第 8 卦比，那條實線從第二爻移到第五爻。
explanation.en: Correct. Kun below Kan is hexagram 8, Bi, and the solid line moves from the second position to the fifth.

explanation.zh-Hant: 謙是下艮上坤，實線在第三爻。
explanation.en: Qian (Modesty) is Gen below Kun, with its solid line in the third position.

explanation.zh-Hant: 坤六爻全陰。交換位置不會讓實線消失。
explanation.en: Kun is six yin lines. Swapping positions does not make a solid line disappear.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坎下坤：眾在下、險在上，唯一的實線升到第五爻。
summary.en: Kan above, Kun below: the many underneath, danger on top, with the one solid line raised to the fifth place.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出比的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Bi.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出比與師差在哪裡。
objectives.en: State how Bi differs from Shi.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出第五爻這個位置為什麼值得注意。
objectives.en: Say why the fifth position is worth noticing.

structure.zh-Hant: 比的下卦是坤、上卦是坎，和師剛好對調。整卦同樣只有一條實線，但它落在第五爻——上卦的中間。五條斷線在它周圍，整個結構的重心就在那一爻。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Bi is Kun and the upper is Kan — the reverse of Shi. The figure again has a single solid line, but it falls on the fifth line, the middle of the upper trigram. Five broken lines surround it, and the centre of gravity of the whole structure sits there.

plain.zh-Hant: 第五爻在六十四卦裡常被看成「居中又在上」的位置，所以比和師雖然用同樣兩個三爻卦，讀起來差很多：師的著力點在底下，要靠編制；比的著力點在上面，眾人是朝它靠攏的。要注意這是結構上的親附，不保證靠攏的結果是好的。
plain.en: The fifth line is often treated as the place that is both central and high, so although Bi and Shi use the same two trigrams they read quite differently: in Shi the leverage is low down and has to organise; in Bi it is above, and the many gather toward it. Note that this is structural affiliation — it does not promise that gathering will turn out well.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個新單位圍著一位有實務信用的負責人成形，大家願意先照他的判斷走。比描述的是這種向中心靠攏的結構，不代表這個判斷一定對。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a new unit forms around a lead with real practical credibility, and people are willing to follow that judgement for now. Bi describes that structure of gathering toward a centre; it does not mean the judgement is right.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換，看看那條實線回到第幾爻，卦名又變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves and watch which position the solid line returns to, and what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 比裡唯一的實線在第幾爻？
prompt.en: Which is the only solid line in Bi?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。上卦坎的實線在中間，也就是整卦的第五爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The solid line of the upper Kan sits in its middle, the fifth line of the figure.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在第二爻的是師。比的第二爻是斷線。
explanation.en: A solid second line would make Shi. In Bi the second line is broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第六爻是斷線。實線在第六爻、其餘全斷的是剝。
explanation.en: The sixth line is broken. A solid sixth line with the rest broken would make Bo.

prompt.zh-Hant: 比和師的關係是什麼？
prompt.en: How are Bi and Shi related?

text.zh-Hant: 同樣的坤與坎，上下位置相反
text.en: The same Kun and Kan, with their positions reversed

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。師是下坎上坤，比是下坤上坎。
explanation.en: Correct. Shi is Kan below Kun; Bi is Kun below Kan.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦的陰陽數量相同，差的是位置。
explanation.en: The two have the same number of yang lines; what differs is position.

text.en: Bi is Shi with its bottom line flipped

explanation.zh-Hant: 翻面只動一爻。這兩卦差的是整組三爻搬位置。
explanation.en: Flipping moves one line. These two differ by whole trigrams changing place.

prompt.zh-Hant: 第五爻這個位置為什麼常被看重？
prompt.en: Why is the fifth position often treated as significant?

text.zh-Hant: 它在上卦的中間，既居中又在上
text.en: It is the middle of the upper trigram: central and high at once

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。這是結構上的位置關係，和那一爻是陰是陽要分開看。
explanation.en: Correct. That is a structural fact about position, to be judged separately from whether the line is yin or yang.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第五爻可以是陰也可以是陽。師的第五爻就是斷線。
explanation.en: The fifth line can be either. In Shi it is broken.

text.zh-Hant: 因為它是整卦最上面那一爻
text.en: Because it is the topmost line

explanation.zh-Hant: 最上面那一爻是第六爻。
explanation.en: The topmost line is the sixth.

summary.zh-Hant: 上巽下乾：推力在下，上面只有一條陰爻在攔。
summary.en: Xun above, Qian below: drive underneath, with a single yin line holding it back.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出小畜的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Xiao Xu.

objectives.zh-Hant: 找出整卦唯一那條斷線在第幾爻。
objectives.en: Find which line is the only broken one.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼它叫「小」畜。
objectives.en: Explain why the restraint here is called “small”.

structure.zh-Hant: 小畜的下卦是乾、上卦是巽。整卦六爻只有第四爻是斷線，其餘五爻都是實線。那一條斷線剛好落在上卦的最下面，也就是推力往上走時第一個遇到的位置。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Xiao Xu is Qian and the upper is Xun. Of the six lines only the fourth is broken; the other five are solid. That broken line sits at the bottom of the upper trigram — the first place the rising force meets.

plain.zh-Hant: 五條實線配一條斷線，攔的力量明顯比推的力量小，所以叫「小畜」：畜是蓄、是攔住，小是說攔得有限。這個結構不是講阻力很強，而是講阻力雖小卻剛好擋在要道上。小阻力放對位置，一樣能讓整件事卡住。
plain.en: Five solid lines against one broken one: the restraining force is clearly smaller than the pushing force, hence “small restraint” — restraint that is limited. The structure is not about strong resistance but about a small resistance sitting exactly across the path. A small obstacle in the right place can still hold everything up.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一件所有人都同意的事，卡在一張還沒簽的表單上。阻力很小，位置很關鍵。小畜描述的是這個結構，不是說這件事最後會不會過。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: something everyone agrees on, held up by one unsigned form. The resistance is tiny and the position is decisive. Xiao Xu describes that structure; it says nothing about whether the thing finally goes through.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：巽移到下面、乾移到上面，看看那條斷線跑到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Xun moves down and Qian moves up, and see which position the broken line lands in.

prompt.zh-Hant: 小畜唯一的斷線在第幾爻？
prompt.en: Which is the only broken line in Xiao Xu?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。上卦巽的斷線在最下面，也就是整卦的第四爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The broken line of the upper Xun is its lowest, which is the fourth line of the figure.

explanation.zh-Hant: 斷線在初爻、其餘全實的是姤。小畜的初爻是實線。
explanation.en: A broken first line with the rest solid would be Gou. The first line of Xiao Xu is solid.

explanation.zh-Hant: 斷線在第六爻的是夬。小畜的第六爻是實線。
explanation.en: A broken sixth line would make Guai. The sixth line of Xiao Xu is solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「小畜」的「小」指的是什麼？
prompt.en: What does the “small” in Xiao Xu refer to?

text.zh-Hant: 攔的力量小，只有一條陰爻
text.en: The restraint is small: just one yin line

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。五實一斷，攔的那一邊明顯弱，但位置關鍵。
explanation.en: Correct. Five solid against one broken: the restraining side is clearly weaker, though well placed.

explanation.zh-Hant: 六十四卦都是六爻，沒有大小之分。
explanation.en: All sixty-four hexagrams have six lines; none is physically smaller.

text.en: It refers to the lower trigram having three lines

explanation.zh-Hant: 每個三爻卦都是三爻，這不是「小」的來源。
explanation.en: Every trigram has three lines; that is not where “small” comes from.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把小畜的上下卦交換，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Swap the halves of Xiao Xu. Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下巽上乾是第 44 卦姤，那條斷線從第四爻移到初爻。
explanation.en: Correct. Xun below Qian is hexagram 44, Gou, and the broken line moves from the fourth position to the first.

explanation.zh-Hant: 夬是下乾上兌，斷線在第六爻。
explanation.en: Guai is Qian below Dui, with its broken line in the sixth position.

explanation.zh-Hant: 大有是下乾上離，有兩條斷線。
explanation.en: Da You is Qian below Li and has two broken lines.

summary.zh-Hant: 上乾下兌：唯一的斷線在第三爻，正踩在兩個三爻卦的交界。
summary.en: Qian above, Dui below: the one broken line is the third, right at the seam between the trigrams.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出履的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Lü.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出那條斷線的位置為什麼要緊。
objectives.en: Say why the position of the broken line matters.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出履的上下卦交換之後是夬。
objectives.en: Work out that Treading with its halves swapped is Resolute Parting.

structure.zh-Hant: 履的下卦是兌：下兩爻實線、最上面一爻斷線。上卦是乾，三爻全實。整卦唯一的斷線在第三爻，也就是下卦的最上面——下卦與上卦交接的那一格。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Lü is Dui: two solid lines with a broken one on top. The upper is Qian, all solid. The only broken line in the figure is the third — the top of the lower trigram, the step where the two halves meet.

plain.zh-Hant: 整卦五條實線，硬的力量很足；唯一柔的那一爻卻正好站在交界上。這個位置被讀成「踩」：腳下那一步是軟的，上面壓著的是整組乾。它提醒的是落腳處，而不是能力：力氣夠不代表那一步踩得穩。
plain.en: With five solid lines the firm force is ample, yet the single yielding line stands exactly at the seam. That position is read as “treading”: the step underfoot is soft while a whole Qian presses from above. The caution is about footing, not ability — having strength does not mean the step is secure.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個條件都齊備的計畫，唯一不確定的是交接那一段由誰負責。能力不是問題，交界處才是。履描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a plan with everything in place except who owns the hand-over step. Capability is not the issue; the seam is. Lü describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：兌移到上面、乾移到下面，看看那條斷線跑到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Dui moves up and Qian moves down, and see where the broken line goes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 履的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Lü?

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻實、第二爻實、第三爻斷，那是兌。
explanation.en: Correct. Solid, solid, broken from the bottom: that is Dui.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 巽的斷線在最下面。履的初爻是實線。
explanation.en: Xun has its broken line at the bottom. The first line of Lü is solid.

explanation.zh-Hant: 乾在履裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Lü, Qian is the upper trigram.

prompt.zh-Hant: 第三爻這個位置特別在哪裡？
prompt.en: What is special about the third position?

text.zh-Hant: 它是下卦的最上面，和上卦交界
text.en: It is the top of the lower trigram, where the halves meet

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第三爻與第四爻之間就是兩個三爻卦的接縫。
explanation.en: Correct. The seam between the two trigrams runs between the third and fourth lines.

text.zh-Hant: 它是整卦的中間，所以最重要
text.en: It is the middle of the figure and therefore the most important

explanation.zh-Hant: 居中的位置傳統上指第二爻與第五爻，各是一個三爻卦的中間。
explanation.en: The central positions are traditionally the second and fifth, each the middle of a trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第三爻可以是陰也可以是陽，乾的第三爻就是實線。
explanation.en: The third line can be either; in Qian it is solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把履的上下卦交換，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Swap the halves of Lü. Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下乾上兌是第 43 卦夬，那條斷線從第三爻移到第六爻。
explanation.en: Correct. Qian below Dui is hexagram 43, Guai, and the broken line moves from the third position to the sixth.

explanation.zh-Hant: 小畜是下乾上巽，斷線在第四爻。
explanation.en: Xiao Xu is Qian below Xun, with its broken line in the fourth position.

explanation.zh-Hant: 同人是下離上乾，下卦有一條斷線在中間。
explanation.en: Tong Ren is Li below Qian, whose lower trigram is broken in the middle.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坤下乾：同樣的乾與坤，放在這個位置就是泰。
summary.en: Earth above, Heaven below: the same two trigrams, arranged this way, form Tai.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出泰的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Tai.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼位置改變，卦就跟著改變。
objectives.en: Explain why changing the position changes the hexagram.

objectives.zh-Hant: 把泰與否的結構差異講清楚。
objectives.en: State the structural difference between Tai and Pi.

structure.zh-Hant: 泰由兩個三爻卦疊成：下卦是乾，三條實線；上卦是坤，三條斷線。由下往上數，前三爻是陽，後三爻是陰。讀卦一律由下往上，所以「下乾上坤」描述的是同一張圖。
structure.en: Tai is built from two trigrams: the lower is Qian, three solid lines; the upper is Kun, three broken lines. Counting from the bottom, the first three lines are yang and the last three are yin. Hexagrams are always read from the bottom up, so “Qian below, Kun above” describes this same picture.

plain.zh-Hant: 乾代表天、代表往上走的力量；坤代表地、代表承載與向下。泰把乾放在下面、坤放在上面，兩股力量朝彼此移動，於是有了交會。傳統上用「通」來形容這個結構——不是說事情一定順利，而是說這個排列描述的是「交流得起來」的狀態。
plain.en: Qian stands for heaven and for upward force; Kun stands for earth, for carrying and for moving downward. Tai puts Qian underneath and Kun on top, so the two forces move toward each other and meet. Tradition describes this structure as “open” — not a promise that things will go well, but a picture of a state in which exchange is possible.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊裡，主管願意先聽、把決定權往下放，第一線願意把實況往上講。位置看起來上下顛倒，訊息卻走得通。泰描述的就是這種結構，不代表這個團隊一定會成功。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: in a team, the manager listens first and pushes decisions downward, while the front line reports what is really happening upward. The positions look inverted, yet information flows. Tai describes that kind of structure; it does not mean the team will succeed.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換，看看卦象、卦名與說明怎麼一起變。這是整組三爻換位置，不是某一爻翻面。
instruction.en: Swap the upper and lower trigrams and watch the figure, the name and the text change together. This moves a whole trigram; it is not a single line flipping.

prompt.zh-Hant: 泰的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Tai?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。由下往上的前三爻都是陽，那是乾。
explanation.en: Correct. The bottom three lines are all yang, which is Qian.

explanation.zh-Hant: 坤在泰裡是上卦，不是下卦。由下往上數，前三爻是實線的乾。
explanation.en: In Tai, Kun is the upper trigram, not the lower one. Counting from the bottom, the first three lines are the solid lines of Qian.

explanation.zh-Hant: 離的中間那爻是斷的，泰的下半三爻全是實線。
explanation.en: Li has a broken middle line; the lower half of Tai is entirely solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把泰的上下卦交換，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Swap the two halves of Tai. Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。乾移到上面、坤移到下面，就是否。
explanation.en: Correct. Qian moves to the top and Kun to the bottom, which is Pi.

explanation.zh-Hant: 乾是六爻全陽。交換上下卦不會改變陰陽的數量，只改變位置；答案是否。
explanation.en: Qian is six yang lines. Swapping halves changes position, not how many lines are yang; the answer is Pi.

explanation.zh-Hant: 上下卦不一樣時，交換之後一定變成另一卦。這裡會變成否。
explanation.en: When the two halves differ, swapping always produces a different hexagram — here, Pi.

prompt.zh-Hant: 泰與否之間的差別，最準確的說法是什麼？
prompt.en: What is the most accurate description of the difference between Tai and Pi?

text.zh-Hant: 組成一樣，上下位置不同

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。兩卦都由乾與坤組成，差別只在誰在上面。
explanation.en: Correct. Both are made of Qian and Kun; only which one sits on top differs.

text.en: One line flips between yin and yang

explanation.zh-Hant: 那是動爻，一次只動一爻。泰與否相差的是整組三爻的位置，六爻全部換了位置。
explanation.en: That describes a moving line, which changes one line. Tai and Pi differ by whole trigrams changing places.

text.zh-Hant: 只是卦名不同，圖形一樣
text.en: Only the names differ; the figures are the same

explanation.zh-Hant: 圖形不一樣：泰是下三實上三斷，否剛好相反。
explanation.en: The figures differ: Tai is solid below and broken above; Pi is the reverse.

summary.zh-Hant: 上乾下坤：和泰同樣的兩個三爻卦，位置對調就是否。
summary.en: Heaven above, Earth below: the same two trigrams as Tai, with their positions exchanged.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出否的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Pi.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說明為什麼否被描述為不交。
objectives.en: Explain why Pi is described as a state without exchange.

objectives.zh-Hant: 分辨「交換上下卦」與「動爻」的差別。
objectives.en: Tell apart swapping trigrams and a moving line.

structure.zh-Hant: 否的下卦是坤，三條斷線；上卦是乾，三條實線。由下往上數，前三爻是陰，後三爻是陽。和泰用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只是位置對調。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Pi is Kun, three broken lines; the upper is Qian, three solid lines. Counting from the bottom, the first three lines are yin and the last three are yang. It uses the same two trigrams as Tai, with their places exchanged.

plain.zh-Hant: 乾往上、坤往下，如果乾已經在上面、坤已經在下面，兩股力量就各走各的，愈走愈遠。傳統上用「不交」形容這個結構。這是對排列的描述，不是對運勢的判斷。
plain.en: Qian moves up and Kun moves down. If Qian is already on top and Kun already below, the two forces travel apart. Tradition calls this “not meeting.” That is a description of the arrangement, not a verdict about fortune.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個組織裡，上層只發公告、不聽回饋，下層只做交辦、不講實況。兩邊都在動，卻沒有交會。否描述的是這種結構，不代表這個組織一定會失敗。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: in an organisation, leadership only announces and never listens, while the front line only executes and never reports. Both sides are busy, yet nothing meets. Pi describes that structure; it does not mean the organisation will fail.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換，看看否怎麼回到泰。整組三爻換位置，不是翻動某一爻。
instruction.en: Swap the two halves and watch Pi return to Tai. Whole trigrams change places; no single line flips.

prompt.zh-Hant: 否的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Pi?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。否是上乾下坤，最上面三爻都是實線。
explanation.en: Correct. Pi is Qian above Kun; the top three lines are solid.

explanation.zh-Hant: 坤在否裡是下卦。最上面那三爻是實線的乾。
explanation.en: In Pi, Kun is the lower trigram. The top three lines are the solid lines of Qian.

explanation.zh-Hant: 坎的上下兩爻是斷的，否的上半三爻全是實線。
explanation.en: Kan has broken outer lines; the upper half of Pi is entirely solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 由下往上數，否的第四爻是陰還是陽？
prompt.en: Counting from the bottom, is the fourth line of Pi yin or yang?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。前三爻是坤的陰爻，第四爻開始進入上卦乾，是陽。
explanation.en: Correct. The first three lines belong to Kun and are yin; the fourth begins the upper trigram Qian and is yang.

explanation.zh-Hant: 陰爻在否的下半，也就是第一到第三爻。第四爻已經屬於上卦乾，是陽。
explanation.en: The yin lines are the lower half, lines one to three. The fourth line already belongs to Qian and is yang.

text.en: It depends on the moving lines

explanation.zh-Hant: 動爻是另一回事。本卦的每一爻是陰是陽，看圖就定了。
explanation.en: Moving lines are a separate matter. Whether each line of the hexagram itself is yin or yang is fixed by the figure.

prompt.zh-Hant: 要從否得到泰，正確的操作是什麼？
prompt.en: What operation turns Pi into Tai?

text.zh-Hant: 把上下兩個三爻卦交換位置

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。乾移到下面、坤移到上面，就回到泰。
explanation.en: Correct. Qian moves below and Kun above, giving Tai.

text.en: Flip the first line to yang

explanation.zh-Hant: 只翻第一爻會得到另一卦，不是泰。泰與否相差的是整組三爻的位置。
explanation.en: Flipping only the first line gives a different hexagram, not Tai. Tai and Pi differ by whole trigrams.

explanation.zh-Hant: 起卦是另一件事。這一節講的是結構：交換上下卦就會得到另一卦。
explanation.en: Casting is a separate activity. This section is about structure: exchanging the halves yields the other hexagram.

summary.zh-Hant: 上乾下離：唯一的斷線在第二爻，被整組乾罩在上面。
summary.en: Qian above, Li below: the one broken line is the second, with a whole Qian above it.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出同人的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Tong Ren.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出同人與大有在結構上的關係。
objectives.en: State how Tong Ren and Da You are related.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼乾的二爻動會得到同人。
objectives.en: Explain why a moving second line in Qian gives Tong Ren.

structure.zh-Hant: 同人的下卦是離：上下兩爻實線、中間一爻斷線。上卦是乾，三爻全實。整卦只有第二爻是斷線，那是下卦的中間。乾的第二爻翻成陰，得到的就是這一卦。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Tong Ren is Li: solid, broken, solid. The upper is Qian, all solid. Only the second line of the figure is broken, and that is the middle of the lower trigram. Flip the second line of Qian to yin and you get exactly this hexagram.

plain.zh-Hant: 離有明的意思，乾有同的意思。五條實線裡那一條柔爻站在下卦的中間，不是夾縫，而是居中的位置。這個結構被讀成「同人」——不同的力量能聚到一起，靠的是中間那個站得住的位置，而不是靠把差異抹掉。
plain.en: Li carries the sense of brightness, Qian of what is shared. Among five solid lines, the single yielding line stands in the middle of the lower trigram — not squeezed in, but centred. The structure is read as “fellowship”: different forces can come together because something holds the centre, not because differences are erased.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：幾個立場不同的小組願意一起做一件事，因為中間有一個被大家接受的協調角色。同人描述的是這種結構，不保證合作順利。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: several groups with different positions agree to work on one thing because a coordinating role in the middle is accepted by all of them. Tong Ren describes that structure; it does not guarantee the collaboration goes smoothly.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：離移到上面、乾移到下面，看看斷線跑到第幾爻、卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Li moves up and Qian moves down, and watch where the broken line goes and what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 同人唯一的斷線在第幾爻？
prompt.en: Which is the only broken line in Tong Ren?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦離的斷線在中間，也就是整卦的第二爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The broken line of the lower Li is its middle, the second line of the figure.

explanation.zh-Hant: 斷線在第五爻、其餘全實的是大有。
explanation.en: A broken fifth line with the rest solid would be Da You.

explanation.zh-Hant: 斷線在第三爻的是履。
explanation.en: A broken third line would make Lü.

prompt.zh-Hant: 乾的第二爻翻成陰，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Flip the second line of Qian to yin. Which hexagram results?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦從乾變成離，上卦還是乾。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower trigram becomes Li while the upper stays Qian.

explanation.zh-Hant: 姤是初爻翻面的結果，不是第二爻。
explanation.en: Gou comes from flipping the first line, not the second.

explanation.zh-Hant: 大有斷的是第五爻，在上卦。
explanation.en: Da You has its broken line in the fifth position, in the upper trigram.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把同人的上下卦交換，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Swap the halves of Tong Ren. Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下乾上離是第 14 卦大有，那條斷線從第二爻移到第五爻。
explanation.en: Correct. Qian below Li is hexagram 14, Da You, and the broken line moves from the second position to the fifth.

explanation.zh-Hant: 交換位置不會讓斷線消失。
explanation.en: Swapping positions does not remove a broken line.

explanation.zh-Hant: 履是下兌上乾，斷線在第三爻。
explanation.en: Lü is Dui below Qian, with its broken line in the third position.

summary.zh-Hant: 上離下乾：唯一的斷線升到第五爻，底下整組乾托著。
summary.en: Li above, Qian below: the one broken line rises to the fifth place, with a whole Qian beneath.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出大有的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Da You.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出大有與同人差在哪裡。
objectives.en: State how Da You differs from Tong Ren.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼「大」指的是份量而不是尺寸。
objectives.en: Explain why “great” here refers to scale, not size.

structure.zh-Hant: 大有的下卦是乾、上卦是離，和同人剛好對調。整卦唯一的斷線在第五爻，也就是上卦的中間。底下三爻全是實線，整個結構是「厚底」加上一個居上的柔位。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Da You is Qian and the upper is Li — the reverse of Tong Ren. The only broken line is the fifth, the middle of the upper trigram. The bottom three lines are all solid, so the structure is a thick base with a yielding place held high.

plain.zh-Hant: 五條實線在下、柔爻在上居中，描述的是「擁有得多」的結構：底子厚，而最上面的主位不是用硬碰硬的方式在管。「大」說的是份量，不是尺寸；而份量大也意味著要守的東西多，所以傳統上這一卦後面接的都是提醒，不是慶賀。
plain.en: Five solid lines below with a yielding line centred above pictures having a great deal: the base is thick and the governing place above does not rule by force. “Great” refers to scale rather than size — and scale also means more to keep safe, which is why tradition follows this hexagram with cautions rather than congratulations.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個資源與人力都到位的部門，主管用授權而不是盯人的方式運作。大有描述的是這種結構，不是說這個部門一定做得好。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a department with both resources and people in place, run by delegation rather than supervision. Da You describes that structure; it does not say the department performs well.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換，看看會回到哪一卦，斷線又落在第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves and see which hexagram you return to, and where the broken line lands.

prompt.zh-Hant: 大有的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Da You?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻實、第五爻斷、第六爻實，那是離。
explanation.en: Correct. Solid, broken, solid from the fourth line up: that is Li.

explanation.zh-Hant: 乾在大有裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Da You, Qian is the lower trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 坎中間那爻是實的，和離剛好相反。
explanation.en: Kan has a solid middle line, the reverse of Li.

prompt.zh-Hant: 大有和同人的關係是什麼？
prompt.en: How are Da You and Tong Ren related?

text.zh-Hant: 同樣的乾與離，上下位置相反
text.en: The same Qian and Li, with their positions reversed

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。同人是下離上乾，大有是下乾上離。
explanation.en: Correct. Tong Ren is Li below Qian; Da You is Qian below Li.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦都是五實一斷，差的是那條斷線的位置。
explanation.en: Both have five solid lines and one broken; what differs is where the broken line sits.

text.zh-Hant: 大有是同人的第五爻翻面
text.en: Da You is Tong Ren with its fifth line flipped

explanation.zh-Hant: 那會變成六爻全陽的乾。兩卦差的是整組三爻搬位置。
explanation.en: That would give six yang lines, Qian. These two differ by whole trigrams changing place.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「大有」的「大」指的是什麼？
prompt.en: What does the “great” in Da You refer to?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。它說的是份量，連帶也是要守的東西變多。
explanation.en: Correct. It speaks of scale, and with it of having more to keep safe.

explanation.zh-Hant: 六十四卦的卦象都是六爻，大小一樣。
explanation.en: All sixty-four figures have six lines and are the same size.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦描述結構，不保證結果；傳統上這一卦後面都是提醒。
explanation.en: A hexagram describes structure, not outcome; tradition follows this one with cautions.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坤下艮：唯一的實線在第三爻，上面壓著整組坤。
summary.en: Kun above, Gen below: the one solid line is the third, with a whole Kun resting above it.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出謙的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Qian (Modesty).

objectives.zh-Hant: 找出整卦唯一那條實線在第幾爻。
objectives.en: Find which line is the only solid one.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出「山在地下」這個圖像指的是什麼。
objectives.en: Say what the image of a mountain below the earth refers to.

structure.zh-Hant: 謙的下卦是艮：下兩爻斷線、最上面一爻實線。上卦是坤，三爻全斷。整卦只有第三爻是實線。艮是山、坤是地，所以這一卦的圖像是「山在地下面」。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Qian is Gen: two broken lines with a solid one on top. The upper is Kun, all broken. Only the third line of the figure is solid. Gen is a mountain and Kun is the earth, so the image here is a mountain beneath the ground.

plain.zh-Hant: 山本來高過地面，這個卦偏偏把山放在地下。那條唯一的實線確實有份量，但它不在最上面，而在下卦的頂端。結構上讀成「有而不居其上」——有東西，位置卻放低。這不是軟弱，是把實力放在不顯眼的位置。
plain.en: A mountain normally rises above the ground, yet this figure places it underneath. The single solid line genuinely has weight, but it is not at the top; it is at the head of the lower trigram. Structurally this reads as having something and not sitting above it — not weakness, but strength placed where it does not show.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一位技術最強的人選擇不掛頭銜、只在需要時出手。謙描述的是這個結構，不是說這樣做一定比較好。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: the strongest engineer on a team chooses to hold no title and step in only when needed. Qian describes that structure; it does not say this is the better choice.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：艮移到上面、坤移到下面，看看那條實線跑到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Gen moves up and Kun moves down, and see where the solid line goes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 謙唯一的實線在第幾爻？
prompt.en: Which is the only solid line in Qian (Modesty)?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦艮的實線在最上面，也就是整卦的第三爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The solid line of the lower Gen is its top, the third line of the figure.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在第六爻、其餘全斷的是剝。
explanation.en: A solid sixth line with the rest broken would be Bo.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在初爻的是復。
explanation.en: A solid first line would make Fu.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「山在地下」這個圖像從哪裡來？
prompt.en: Where does the image of a mountain below the earth come from?

text.zh-Hant: 下卦是艮（山）、上卦是坤（地）
text.en: The lower trigram is Gen (mountain) and the upper is Kun (earth)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。讀卦由下往上，山在下、地在上。
explanation.en: Correct. Read from the bottom up: the mountain is below and the earth above.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那是剝的排法，不是謙。
explanation.en: That arrangement is Bo, not Qian.

text.en: All six lines are yin, so it is earth

explanation.zh-Hant: 六爻全陰是坤。謙有一條實線。
explanation.en: Six yin lines would be Kun. Qian has one solid line.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把謙的上下卦交換，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Swap the halves of Qian (Modesty). Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下坤上艮是第 23 卦剝，那條實線從第三爻移到第六爻。
explanation.en: Correct. Kun below Gen is hexagram 23, Bo, and the solid line moves from the third position to the sixth.

explanation.zh-Hant: 豫是下坤上震，實線在第四爻。
explanation.en: Yu is Kun below Zhen, with its solid line in the fourth position.

explanation.zh-Hant: 坤六爻全陰，一條實線都沒有；交換位置不會把實線變掉。
explanation.en: Kun is six yin lines; swapping does not remove a solid line.

summary.zh-Hant: 上震下坤：唯一的實線在第四爻，剛跨過上下卦的交界。
summary.en: Zhen above, Kun below: the one solid line is the fourth, just across the seam.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出豫的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Yu.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼那條實線放在第四爻會讀成「動得起來」。
objectives.en: Explain why a solid line in the fourth place reads as movement starting.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出豫的上下卦交換之後是復。
objectives.en: Work out that Enthusiasm with its halves swapped is Returning.

structure.zh-Hant: 豫的下卦是坤，三爻全斷；上卦是震，最下面一爻實線、上面兩爻斷線。整卦唯一的實線在第四爻，也就是上卦的起點。震是動，所以動的那一下發生在剛跨過交界的位置。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Yu is Kun, all broken; the upper is Zhen, with a solid line at its base and two broken above. The only solid line in the figure is the fourth — the start of the upper trigram. Zhen is movement, so the stirring happens just across the seam.

plain.zh-Hant: 底下三爻全是坤，承載的面很寬；真正動的只有第四爻那一條實線。結構上讀成「底盤夠寬，所以動得起來」。它常被講成愉悅或奮起，但更穩的說法是：這個動不是硬推出來的，而是有足夠的承載才動得動。
plain.en: The three Kun lines below give a wide base; what actually moves is the single solid fourth line. Structurally this reads as movement being possible because the base is broad. It is often glossed as delight or rousing, but a steadier reading is this: the movement is not forced out — there is enough support beneath it for movement to happen at all.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個準備很久的活動終於開始報名，前期的瑣事都鋪好了，動起來很快。豫描述的是這種結構，不是說活動會成功。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: an event that has been prepared for a long time opens registration; the groundwork is laid and things move quickly. Yu describes that structure; it does not say the event succeeds.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：震移到下面、坤移到上面，看看那條實線回到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Zhen moves down and Kun moves up, and see where the solid line lands.

prompt.zh-Hant: 豫唯一的實線在第幾爻？
prompt.en: Which is the only solid line in Yu?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。上卦震的實線在最下面，也就是整卦的第四爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The solid line of the upper Zhen is its lowest, the fourth line of the figure.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在初爻的是復，下卦會是震。
explanation.en: A solid first line would make Fu, whose lower trigram is Zhen.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在第五爻的是比。
explanation.en: A solid fifth line would make Bi.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼說豫的動是「有承載才動得動」？
prompt.en: Why is the movement in Yu said to rest on support?

text.zh-Hant: 下卦三爻全是坤，先有寬的底盤
text.en: The lower trigram is all Kun: a broad base comes first

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。動的那一爻在上面，底下是整組承載的坤。
explanation.en: Correct. The moving line is above, and beneath it lies a whole supporting Kun.

text.en: Because the upper trigram is Kan

explanation.zh-Hant: 豫的上卦是震，不是坎。
explanation.en: The upper trigram of Yu is Zhen, not Kan.

text.en: Because all six lines are yang

explanation.zh-Hant: 豫只有一條實線。
explanation.en: Yu has only one solid line.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把豫的上下卦交換，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Swap the halves of Yu. Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下震上坤是第 24 卦復，那條實線從第四爻移到初爻。
explanation.en: Correct. Zhen below Kun is hexagram 24, Fu, and the solid line moves from the fourth position to the first.

explanation.zh-Hant: 謙的實線在第三爻，下卦是艮，不是坤。
explanation.en: Qian (Modesty) is Gen below Kun, with its solid line third.

explanation.zh-Hant: 師是下坎上坤，實線在第二爻。
explanation.en: Shi is Kan below Kun, with its solid line second.

summary.zh-Hant: 上兌下震：動在下、悅在上，跟著走的那個結構。
summary.en: Dui above, Zhen below: movement underneath, pleasure above — the structure of following.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出隨的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Sui.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼「動在下、悅在上」讀成相隨。
objectives.en: Explain why movement below and pleasure above reads as following.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出隨與歸妹用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Following and The Marrying Maiden use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 隨的下卦是震：初爻實線、上面兩爻斷線。上卦是兌：下兩爻實線、最上面一爻斷線。整卦第一、第四、第五爻是實線。這一卦也是第八堂案例的本卦：初爻動，變成萃。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Sui is Zhen: a solid first line with two broken above. The upper is Dui: two solid lines with a broken one on top. The first, fourth and fifth lines are solid. This is also the primary hexagram in the lesson-eight worked example: with the first line moving, it becomes Cui.

plain.zh-Hant: 震是動、兌是悅。動的那一端在下面，願意跟的那一端在上面，所以這個結構讀成相隨。要注意「隨」不是服從：卦裡動的力量在下卦，是下面先動，上面才跟。方向感錯了，整卦的讀法就反了。
plain.en: Zhen is movement and Dui is pleasure. The moving end is below and the willing end above, so the structure reads as following. Note that following is not obedience: the moving force sits in the lower trigram, so what is below moves first and what is above goes along. Get the direction wrong and the whole reading inverts.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個小組先做出可用的東西，其他人看到之後願意照這個做法走。隨描述的是這種結構，不是說這個做法一定對。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: one team ships something usable first, and others, seeing it, are willing to adopt the same approach. Sui describes that structure; it does not say the approach is correct.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：兌移到下面、震移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Dui moves down and Zhen moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 隨的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Sui?

text.en: Zhen (one solid below, two broken above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻實、第二爻斷、第三爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Solid, broken, broken from the bottom.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌在隨裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Sui, Dui is the upper trigram.

text.en: Gen (two broken below, one solid on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 艮的實線在最上面，隨的下卦實線在最下面。
explanation.en: Gen has its solid line on top; the lower trigram of Sui has it at the bottom.

prompt.zh-Hant: 隨的初爻動，會變成哪一卦？
prompt.en: The first line of Sui moves. Which hexagram results?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻翻成陰，下卦從震變成坤，那是第 45 卦萃。
explanation.en: Correct. With the first line flipped to yin the lower trigram becomes Kun, giving hexagram 45, Cui.

explanation.zh-Hant: 歸妹是上下卦交換的結果，不是翻一爻。
explanation.en: Gui Mei comes from swapping the halves, not from flipping a line.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌是上下卦都是兌。隨只有上卦是兌。
explanation.en: Dui has Dui in both halves; in Sui only the upper half is Dui.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把隨的上下卦交換，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Swap the halves of Sui. Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下兌上震是第 54 卦歸妹。
explanation.en: Correct. Dui below Zhen is hexagram 54, Gui Mei.

explanation.zh-Hant: 萃是初爻翻面的結果，那是動爻，不是交換。
explanation.en: Cui comes from flipping the first line — a moving line, not a swap.

explanation.zh-Hant: 蠱是下巽上艮，兩個三爻卦都不一樣。
explanation.en: Gu is Xun below Gen; both trigrams differ.

summary.zh-Hant: 上艮下巽：風吹在山下，停了太久的那個結構。
summary.en: Gen above, Xun below: wind beneath a mountain — the structure of something left too long.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出蠱的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Gu.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出「風在山下」為什麼讀成積弊。
objectives.en: Explain why wind beneath a mountain reads as accumulated decay.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，蠱會變成漸。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns Repairing What Has Decayed into Gradual Progress.

structure.zh-Hant: 蠱的下卦是巽：初爻斷線、上面兩爻實線。上卦是艮：下兩爻斷線、最上面一爻實線。整卦第二、第三、第六爻是實線。巽是風、艮是山，圖像是風被山擋在底下。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Gu is Xun: a broken first line with two solid above. The upper is Gen: two broken lines with a solid one on top. The second, third and sixth lines are solid. Xun is wind and Gen is a mountain, so the image is wind trapped beneath a mountain.

plain.zh-Hant: 風本來會流動，被山壓在下面就散不出去。結構上讀成「該換的沒換、該清的沒清」，問題不是突然發生的，是長期不流動造成的。這一卦談的是整治，重點在找出哪一段停住了，而不是責怪。
plain.en: Wind naturally moves; pressed beneath a mountain it cannot disperse. Structurally this reads as what should have been changed never being changed. The problem did not appear suddenly; it comes from a long absence of circulation. The hexagram is about repair, and its point is finding where the flow stopped rather than assigning blame.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一份三年沒更新的流程文件，大家各自繞路做事，沒人動它。蠱描述的是這種結構，不是說這個團隊不用心。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a process document untouched for three years, with everyone quietly routing around it and nobody revising it. Gu describes that structure; it does not say the team is careless.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：艮移到下面、巽移到上面，看看卦名與上下卦怎麼變。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Gen moves down and Xun moves up, and watch the name and the two halves change.

prompt.zh-Hant: 蠱的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Gu?

text.en: Gen (two broken below, one solid on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻斷、第五爻斷、第六爻實。
explanation.en: Correct. Broken, broken, solid from the fourth line up.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 巽在蠱裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Gu, Xun is the lower trigram.

text.en: Zhen (one solid below, two broken above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 震的實線在最下面，蠱的上卦實線在最上面。
explanation.en: Zhen has its solid line at the bottom; the upper trigram of Gu has it at the top.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「風在山下」為什麼讀成積弊？
prompt.en: Why does wind beneath a mountain read as accumulated decay?

text.zh-Hant: 風流不動，長期不流通就積出問題
text.en: The wind cannot circulate, and a long lack of circulation accumulates problems

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。問題來自停滯，不是突然發生。
explanation.en: Correct. The problem comes from stagnation, not from a sudden event.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦象裡沒有崩的意思，艮是止。
explanation.en: Nothing in the figure says collapse; Gen is stopping.

text.en: Because the lower trigram is Kan, which is danger

explanation.zh-Hant: 蠱的下卦是巽，不是坎。
explanation.en: The lower trigram of Gu is Xun, not Kan.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把蠱的上下卦交換，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Swap the halves of Gu. Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下艮上巽是第 53 卦漸。
explanation.en: Correct. Gen below Xun is hexagram 53, Jian.

explanation.zh-Hant: 隨是下震上兌，兩個三爻卦都不一樣。
explanation.en: Sui is Zhen below Dui; both trigrams differ.

explanation.zh-Hant: 頤是下震上艮，下卦不是艮。
explanation.en: Yi is Zhen below Gen; its lower trigram is not Gen.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坤下兌：兩條實線在最底下，整卦從下往上推。
summary.en: Kun above, Dui below: two solid lines at the very bottom, pushing upward.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出臨的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Lin.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出兩條實線都在最下面代表什麼。
objectives.en: Say what it means for both solid lines to sit at the bottom.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出臨的上下卦交換之後是萃。
objectives.en: Work out that Approaching with its halves swapped is Gathering.

structure.zh-Hant: 臨的下卦是兌：初爻與第二爻實線、第三爻斷線。上卦是坤，三爻全斷。整卦只有最下面兩爻是實線，其餘四爻都是斷線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Lin is Dui: solid first and second lines with a broken third. The upper is Kun, all broken. Only the bottom two lines of the figure are solid; the other four are broken.

plain.zh-Hant: 兩條實線都在最底下，上面四爻全是陰。結構上讀成「剛剛起來、還在下面」：力量是真的，位置還低。傳統把它讀成臨、靠近，重點在時機還早，不在聲勢。這種結構最怕的是把「開始有進展」當成「已經成了」。
plain.en: Both solid lines sit at the very bottom, with four yin lines above. Structurally this reads as something newly risen that is still low down: the force is real, the position is not yet high. Tradition reads it as approaching, and the point is that it is early rather than impressive. The risk in this structure is mistaking early progress for arrival.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個新做法剛被兩個小組採用，其他部門還沒表態。臨描述的是這種剛起來的結構，不是說它會擴散開。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a new practice has just been adopted by two teams while the rest of the organisation has said nothing. Lin describes that early structure; it does not say the practice spreads.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：兌移到上面、坤移到下面，看看兩條實線跑到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Dui moves up and Kun moves down, and see where the two solid lines land.

prompt.zh-Hant: 臨的實線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Lin are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦兌的兩條實線在最下面，第三爻起全是斷線。
explanation.en: Correct. The two solid lines of the lower Dui are at the bottom; from the third line up all are broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在最上面兩爻的是觀的反面排法；臨的上卦三爻全斷。
explanation.en: Solid lines in the top two positions would be a different figure; the upper trigram of Lin is all broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻各在一個三爻卦的中間，不是臨的排法。
explanation.en: Those are the middles of the two trigrams, which is not the arrangement of Lin.

prompt.zh-Hant: 兩條實線都在最下面，結構上代表什麼？
prompt.en: What does it mean structurally that both solid lines are at the bottom?

text.zh-Hant: 力量是真的，但位置還低、時機還早
text.en: The force is real but still low down: it is early

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。這一卦講的是起步階段，不是聲勢。
explanation.en: Correct. The hexagram speaks of an early stage, not of momentum.

text.en: It means the outcome will improve

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦描述結構，不保證結果。
explanation.en: A hexagram describes structure; it promises no outcome.

text.zh-Hant: 代表上面四爻沒有作用
text.en: It means the four lines above do nothing

explanation.zh-Hant: 六爻都算在結構裡，上面四爻是整組坤。
explanation.en: All six lines count; the four above form a whole Kun.

prompt.zh-Hant: 臨的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Lin?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四、第五、第六爻都是斷線。
explanation.en: Correct. The fourth, fifth and sixth lines are all broken.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌在臨裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Lin, Dui is the lower trigram.

text.en: Gen (two broken below, one solid on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 艮最上面那爻是實線，臨的第六爻是斷線。
explanation.en: Gen has a solid top line; the sixth line of Lin is broken.

summary.zh-Hant: 上巽下坤：兩條實線升到最上面，整卦從上往下看。
summary.en: Xun above, Kun below: the two solid lines sit at the very top, looking down.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出觀的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Guan.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼實線在上會讀成「看」。
objectives.en: Explain why solid lines above read as observing.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出觀與升用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Contemplating and Ascending use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 觀的下卦是坤，三爻全斷；上卦是巽：第四爻斷線、第五與第六爻實線。整卦只有最上面兩爻是實線。它和臨剛好是上下顛倒的排法。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Guan is Kun, all broken; the upper is Xun, with a broken fourth line and solid fifth and sixth. Only the top two lines of the figure are solid. It is the vertical mirror of Lin.

plain.zh-Hant: 實線在最上面，底下四爻都是陰。位置高、底下寬，結構上讀成「看得見全局」。這一卦談的是觀察的位置，不是觀察的結論：站得高看得遠，但看到的仍然只是現在的樣子，不是以後的事。
plain.en: The solid lines are at the top with four yin lines beneath. A high position over a broad base reads structurally as seeing the whole. The hexagram is about the vantage point, not the conclusion: height lets you see far, but what you see is still only how things are now, not what will happen.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一位剛接手的負責人先花兩週只看資料、不下指令。觀描述的是這種先取得視野的結構，不是說接下來的決定一定對。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a new lead spends the first two weeks only reading the data and issuing no instructions. Guan describes that structure of gaining a vantage point; it does not say the later decisions are right.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：巽移到下面、坤移到上面，看看兩條實線落到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Xun moves down and Kun moves up, and see where the two solid lines land.

prompt.zh-Hant: 觀和臨的關係是什麼？
prompt.en: How are Guan and Lin related?

text.en: The solid lines are at opposite ends

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。臨的兩條實線在最下面，觀的兩條實線在最上面。
explanation.en: Correct. Lin has its two solid lines at the bottom, Guan at the top.

explanation.zh-Hant: 排列不同就是不同的卦，陰陽數量相同不代表同一卦。
explanation.en: Different arrangements are different hexagrams; having the same count of yang lines does not make them identical.

text.en: Guan comes from flipping one line of Lin

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦有四爻不同，不是一爻翻面。
explanation.en: The two differ in four lines, not one.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼實線在上會讀成「看」？
prompt.en: Why do solid lines above read as observing?

text.zh-Hant: 位置高、底下寬，所以看得到全局
text.en: A high position over a broad base can see the whole

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。這是位置關係，不是結論的保證。
explanation.en: Correct. That is a fact about position, not a guarantee about conclusions.

text.en: Because the upper trigram is Li, which is brightness

explanation.zh-Hant: 觀的上卦是巽，不是離。
explanation.en: The upper trigram of Guan is Xun, not Li.

text.en: Because all six lines are yang

explanation.zh-Hant: 觀只有兩條實線。
explanation.en: Guan has only two solid lines.

prompt.zh-Hant: 觀的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Guan?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻到第三爻都是斷線。
explanation.en: Correct. The first through third lines are all broken.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 巽在觀裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Guan, Xun is the upper trigram.

text.en: Zhen (one solid below, two broken above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 震的初爻是實線，觀的初爻是斷線。
explanation.en: Zhen has a solid first line; the first line of Guan is broken.

summary.zh-Hant: 上離下震：動在下、明在上，把中間那一塊咬開的結構。
summary.en: Li above, Zhen below: movement underneath, brightness above — biting through what sits between.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出噬嗑的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Shi Ke.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出第四爻那條實線在這個結構裡的角色。
objectives.en: Say what the solid fourth line does in this structure.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，噬嗑會變成豐。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns Biting Through into Abundance.

structure.zh-Hant: 噬嗑的下卦是震：初爻實線、上面兩爻斷線。上卦是離：第四爻實線、第五爻斷線、第六爻實線。整卦第一、第四、第六爻是實線，中間夾著一串斷線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Shi Ke is Zhen: a solid first line with two broken above. The upper is Li: solid, broken, solid. The first, fourth and sixth lines are solid, with a run of broken lines in between.

plain.zh-Hant: 上下各有實線，中間卻隔著斷線，整個圖像像是嘴裡有東西擋著。震在下是動，離在上是看得清，於是結構讀成「看清楚了就把擋住的那一塊處理掉」。它談的是處理障礙的方式：先看清，再動；不是靠蠻力。
plain.en: There are solid lines at both ends with broken lines between them, so the image is of something stuck in the mouth. Zhen below is movement and Li above is clear sight, so the structure reads as seeing clearly and then dealing with the obstruction. It concerns how an obstacle is handled — look first, then act, rather than relying on force.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊先把反覆出錯的那一段流程查清楚，再一次改掉，而不是每次都繞過去。噬嗑描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a team first pins down exactly which step keeps failing and then fixes it once, instead of routing around it every time. Shi Ke describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：離移到下面、震移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Li moves down and Zhen moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 噬嗑的實線在哪三爻？
prompt.en: Which three lines of Shi Ke are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦震的實線在初爻，上卦離的實線在第四與第六爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower Zhen is solid at the first line; the upper Li is solid at the fourth and sixth.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那會是下卦乾。噬嗑的第二、第三爻是斷線。
explanation.en: That would be a lower Qian. The second and third lines of Shi Ke are broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 噬嗑的第二爻是斷線，實線在初爻。
explanation.en: The second line of Shi Ke is broken; the solid one is the first.

prompt.zh-Hant: 上卦離在這個結構裡的作用是什麼？
prompt.en: What does the upper trigram Li contribute here?

text.zh-Hant: 看得清，所以知道要處理哪一塊
text.en: Clear sight, so one knows what to deal with

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。離是明，配上下卦的動，才是先看清再動。
explanation.en: Correct. Li is brightness; with the movement below it, the order is to see first and then act.

explanation.zh-Hant: 擋住的是中間那串斷線，不是上卦。
explanation.en: The obstruction is the run of broken lines in the middle, not the upper trigram.

text.en: It brings the figure to a stop

explanation.zh-Hant: 停是艮的事，噬嗑裡沒有艮。
explanation.en: Stopping belongs to Gen, and Shi Ke contains none.

prompt.zh-Hant: 噬嗑的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Shi Ke?

text.en: Zhen (one solid below, two broken above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻實、第二爻斷、第三爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Solid, broken, broken from the bottom.

explanation.zh-Hant: 離在噬嗑裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Shi Ke, Li is the upper trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 坤三爻全斷，噬嗑的初爻是實線。
explanation.en: Kun is all broken; the first line of Shi Ke is solid.

summary.zh-Hant: 上艮下離：明在下、止在上，光照在山腳下的結構。
summary.en: Gen above, Li below: brightness underneath, stopping above — light at the foot of a mountain.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出賁的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Bi (Adornment).

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出「明在下、止在上」為什麼讀成修飾。
objectives.en: Explain why brightness below and stopping above reads as adornment.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出賁的上下卦交換之後是旅。
objectives.en: Work out that Adornment with its halves swapped is The Traveller.

structure.zh-Hant: 賁的下卦是離：初爻實線、第二爻斷線、第三爻實線。上卦是艮：第四與第五爻斷線、第六爻實線。整卦第一、第三、第六爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Bi is Li: solid, broken, solid. The upper is Gen: broken, broken, solid. The first, third and sixth lines of the figure are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 離是光、是看得見的那一面；艮是山、是界線。光照在山腳下，照到的範圍有限，所以這一卦談的是「可見的那一層」。修飾不是虛假，它確實改變別人看到什麼；但它改變的是外層，不是裡面的結構。兩件事要分開。
plain.en: Li is light, the visible side; Gen is a mountain, a boundary. Light at the foot of a mountain lights only so far, so this hexagram concerns the visible layer. Adornment is not falsehood — it genuinely changes what others see — but what it changes is the surface, not the structure beneath. The two should be kept apart.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一份內容沒變、但排版與說明重做過的報告，讀的人確實看懂了。賁描述的是這個結構：外層改善是真的，內容本身沒有被改動。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a report whose content is unchanged but whose layout and framing have been redone, so readers finally follow it. Bi describes that structure: the surface improvement is real, and the content itself was not altered.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：艮移到下面、離移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Gen moves down and Li moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 賁的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Bi (Adornment)?

text.en: Gen (two broken below, one solid on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻斷、第五爻斷、第六爻實。
explanation.en: Correct. Broken, broken, solid from the fourth line up.

explanation.zh-Hant: 離在賁裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Bi, Li is the lower trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 賁的第六爻是實線，不是斷線。
explanation.en: The sixth line of Bi is solid, not broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 賁談的是哪一層？
prompt.en: Which layer does Bi concern?

text.zh-Hant: 看得見的外層，不是底下的結構
text.en: The visible surface, not the structure beneath

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。修飾改變別人看到什麼，不改變內容本身。
explanation.en: Correct. Adornment changes what is seen, not the content itself.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那不是這一卦的位置關係；離在下只照到山腳。
explanation.en: That is not what the positions say; Li below lights only the foot of the mountain.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦沒有說修飾等於作假，它說的是作用範圍有限。
explanation.en: The hexagram does not equate adornment with deceit; it says its reach is limited.

prompt.zh-Hant: 賁的斷線在哪三爻？
prompt.en: Which three lines of Bi are broken?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦離中間斷，上卦艮下面兩爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower Li is broken in the middle; the upper Gen is broken in its lower two lines.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那三爻是實線。
explanation.en: Those three lines are solid.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第六爻是實線，上卦不是坤。
explanation.en: The sixth line is solid, so the upper trigram is not Kun.

summary.zh-Hant: 上艮下坤：唯一的實線孤立在最上面，底下五爻全陰。
summary.en: Gen above, Kun below: the one solid line stands alone at the top over five yin lines.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出剝的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Bo.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼實線孤立在最上面讀成剝落。
objectives.en: Explain why a lone solid line at the top reads as stripping away.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出剝與謙用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Stripping Away and Modesty use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 剝的下卦是坤，三爻全斷；上卦是艮：第四與第五爻斷線、第六爻實線。整卦只有第六爻是實線，底下五爻都是斷線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Bo is Kun, all broken; the upper is Gen, broken at the fourth and fifth and solid at the sixth. Only the sixth line of the figure is solid; the five beneath it are broken.

plain.zh-Hant: 陰爻從下面一路長到第五爻，只剩最上面那一條實線還在。結構上讀成「一層一層被剝掉」：剩下的那一爻位置最高，支撐卻最少。這不是講災難，而是講比例：底下已經換過了，上面那一層能撐多久是結構問題。
plain.en: Yin lines have grown from the bottom all the way to the fifth place, leaving only the topmost solid line. Structurally this reads as being stripped layer by layer: what remains sits highest and is supported least. This is not a statement about disaster but about proportion — the base has already turned over, and how long the top layer holds is a structural question.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個舊系統只剩一位還熟悉它的工程師，其他相關的人都換過了。剝描述的是這種支撐越來越少的結構，不是說系統明天就會壞。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a legacy system has one engineer left who still knows it, everyone else having moved on. Bo describes that structure of thinning support; it does not say the system fails tomorrow.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：艮移到下面、坤移到上面，看看那條實線跑到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Gen moves down and Kun moves up, and see where the solid line goes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 剝唯一的實線在第幾爻？
prompt.en: Which is the only solid line in Bo?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。上卦艮的實線在最上面。
explanation.en: Correct. The solid line of the upper Gen is its topmost.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在第五爻的是比。剝的第五爻是斷線。
explanation.en: A solid fifth line would make Bi. In Bo the fifth line is broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在第三爻的是謙。
explanation.en: A solid third line would make Qian (Modesty).

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼實線孤立在最上面會讀成剝落？
prompt.en: Why does a lone solid line at the top read as stripping away?

text.zh-Hant: 底下五爻都換成陰，剩下那一爻支撐最少
text.en: The five lines below have all turned to yin, leaving the top least supported

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。這是比例問題，不是結果預測。
explanation.en: Correct. That is a question of proportion, not a prediction.

text.zh-Hant: 因為第六爻一定會消失
text.en: Because the sixth line must disappear

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦象不預言下一步，只描述現在的排列。
explanation.en: The figure does not foretell the next step; it describes the present arrangement.

text.en: Because the upper trigram is Kun

explanation.zh-Hant: 剝的上卦是艮，坤在下卦。
explanation.en: The upper trigram of Bo is Gen; Kun is below.

prompt.zh-Hant: 剝的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Bo?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻到第三爻都是斷線。
explanation.en: Correct. The first through third lines are all broken.

text.en: Gen (two broken below, one solid on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 艮在剝裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Bo, Gen is the upper trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 剝的第二爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The second line of Bo is broken.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坤下震：唯一的實線在最底下，一陽剛剛回來。
summary.en: Kun above, Zhen below: the one solid line is at the very bottom — a single yang just returned.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出復的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Fu.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出復與剝在結構上的對照。
objectives.en: Contrast Fu and Bo structurally.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，復會變成豫。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns Returning into Enthusiasm.

structure.zh-Hant: 復的下卦是震：初爻實線、第二與第三爻斷線。上卦是坤，三爻全斷。整卦只有初爻是實線。它和剝剛好相反：剝只剩最上面一條實線，復是最下面剛出現一條實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Fu is Zhen: a solid first line with two broken above. The upper is Kun, all broken. Only the first line of the figure is solid. It is the counterpart of Bo: Bo retains one solid line at the top, while in Fu one has just appeared at the bottom.

plain.zh-Hant: 一條實線在最底下，上面五爻都是陰。結構上讀成「回來了，但只回來一點」：方向變了，份量還很小。這一卦最常被誤讀成「轉好」，但它說的是起點，不是結果。起點小，所以能不能長成不是這一卦在講的事。
plain.en: One solid line at the very bottom with five yin lines above reads structurally as a return that has only just begun: the direction has changed, the quantity is still tiny. This hexagram is most often misread as “things improve”. What it states is a starting point, not an outcome — and because the start is small, whether it grows is not what this figure addresses.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個停了很久的專案重新有一個人固定在推進，其他都還沒恢復。復描述的是這種剛回來的結構，不是說專案一定會重新上軌道。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a long-stalled project again has one person steadily pushing it, with nothing else restored yet. Fu describes that structure of a return just begun; it does not say the project gets back on track.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：震移到上面、坤移到下面，看看那條實線跑到第幾爻。
