instruction.en: Swap the halves so Zhen moves up and Kun moves down, and see where the solid line goes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 復唯一的實線在第幾爻？
prompt.en: Which is the only solid line in Fu?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦震的實線在最下面，也就是初爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The solid line of the lower Zhen is its lowest, the first line.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在第六爻的是剝，剛好和復相反。
explanation.en: A solid sixth line would make Bo, the counterpart of Fu.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在第四爻的是豫。
explanation.en: A solid fourth line would make Yu.

prompt.zh-Hant: 復和剝的對照是什麼？
prompt.en: How do Fu and Bo contrast?

text.zh-Hant: 剝剩最上面一條實線，復是最下面剛出現一條
text.en: Bo keeps one solid line at the top; in Fu one has just appeared at the bottom

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。同樣是一實五斷，位置在兩端。
explanation.en: Correct. Both have one solid line and five broken; the positions are at opposite ends.

text.en: They have different numbers of yang lines

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦都是一條實線。
explanation.en: Both have exactly one solid line.

text.en: Fu is Bo with its halves swapped

explanation.zh-Hant: 剝交換上下卦會得到謙，不是復。
explanation.en: Swapping the halves of Bo gives Qian (Modesty), not Fu.

prompt.zh-Hant: 復說的是什麼？
prompt.en: What does Fu state?

text.zh-Hant: 方向變了，但份量還很小
text.en: The direction has changed, but the quantity is still small

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。它講起點，不講結果。
explanation.en: Correct. It speaks of a starting point, not an outcome.

explanation.zh-Hant: 一條實線只說明方向，不說明結果。
explanation.en: A single solid line indicates direction, not result.

text.en: The five lines below are yang

explanation.zh-Hant: 復只有初爻是實線，上面五爻都是斷線。
explanation.en: In Fu only the first line is solid; the five above are broken.

summary.zh-Hant: 上乾下震：動在下、剛在上，不摻雜算計的那個結構。
summary.en: Qian above, Zhen below: movement underneath, firmness above — a structure without pretence.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出无妄的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Wu Wang.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出「无妄」在結構上指的是什麼。
objectives.en: Say what “without pretence” means structurally.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出无妄的上下卦交換之後是大壯。
objectives.en: Work out that Without Pretence with its halves swapped is Great Strength.

structure.zh-Hant: 无妄的下卦是震：初爻實線、第二與第三爻斷線。上卦是乾，三爻全實。整卦第一、第四、第五、第六爻是實線。動在最底下那一爻，上面整組是乾。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Wu Wang is Zhen: a solid first line with two broken above. The upper is Qian, all solid. The first, fourth, fifth and sixth lines are solid. The movement is in the lowest line, with a whole Qian above.

plain.zh-Hant: 妄是虛妄、是硬要。无妄就是不硬要：動的那一下在最底下，上面是整組乾，結構上沒有一處是繞路的。它常被講成「順其自然」，但更準確的是「不另外加東西」——照著原本的條件動，不添加算計。這不保證結果，只是說過程裡沒有造假。
plain.en: Wang means false or forced; wu wang is not forcing. The stirring is in the lowest line and a whole Qian stands above, so nothing in the structure is taking a detour. It is often glossed as going along with nature, but more precisely it means adding nothing extra — moving on the conditions as they are, without calculation layered on top. That promises no outcome; it only says the process involves no pretence.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一份如實寫出風險的提案，不美化也不誇大。无妄描述的是這種不加料的結構，不代表提案會被接受。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a proposal that states its risks as they are, neither polished nor inflated. Wu Wang describes that structure of adding nothing; it does not mean the proposal is accepted.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：乾移到下面、震移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Qian moves down and Zhen moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 无妄的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Wu Wang?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四、第五、第六爻都是實線。
explanation.en: Correct. The fourth, fifth and sixth lines are all solid.

text.en: Zhen (one solid below, two broken above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 震在无妄裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Wu Wang, Zhen is the lower trigram.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌最上面那爻是斷的，无妄的第六爻是實線。
explanation.en: Dui has a broken top line; the sixth line of Wu Wang is solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「无妄」在結構上指什麼？
prompt.en: What does “without pretence” mean structurally?

text.zh-Hant: 照原本的條件動，不另外加東西
text.en: Moving on the conditions as they are, adding nothing extra

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。它說的是過程裡沒有造假，不是保證結果。
explanation.en: Correct. It says the process involves no pretence; it is not a guarantee of outcome.

explanation.zh-Hant: 下卦震是動，這一卦有動。
explanation.en: The lower Zhen is movement; this figure does move.

text.en: A guarantee that nothing goes wrong

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦描述結構，不保證結果。
explanation.en: A hexagram describes structure; it guarantees no outcome.

prompt.zh-Hant: 无妄的斷線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Wu Wang are broken?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦震只有初爻是實線。
explanation.en: Correct. In the lower Zhen only the first line is solid.

explanation.zh-Hant: 初爻是實線。
explanation.en: The first line is solid.

explanation.zh-Hant: 上卦乾三爻全實。
explanation.en: The upper Qian is entirely solid.

summary.zh-Hant: 上艮下乾：整組乾被山止在下面，蓄起來的結構。
summary.en: Gen above, Qian below: a whole Qian held beneath a mountain — force accumulating.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出大畜的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Da Xu.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出大畜與小畜差在哪裡。
objectives.en: State how Da Xu differs from Xiao Xu.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出大畜與遯用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Great Accumulating and Retreat use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 大畜的下卦是乾，三爻全實；上卦是艮：第四與第五爻斷線、第六爻實線。整卦第一、第二、第三、第六爻是實線。擋住的那一組在上面，被擋的整組乾在下面。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Da Xu is Qian, all solid; the upper is Gen, broken at the fourth and fifth and solid at the sixth. The first, second, third and sixth lines are solid. The restraining trigram is above and the whole Qian being restrained is below.

plain.zh-Hant: 小畜只有一條陰爻在攔，大畜是整組艮在上面止住。攔的份量大，所以蓄的份量也大——這裡的「畜」是累積，不是壓制。力量沒有消失，只是暫時不往外走。要注意這個結構不告訴你什麼時候放出來，它只說現在是積的階段。
plain.en: In Xiao Xu a single yin line restrains; in Da Xu a whole Gen stops from above. Because the restraint is substantial, so is what accumulates — xu here means accumulating rather than suppressing. The force has not vanished; it simply is not going outward for now. Note that the structure does not say when it is released, only that this is the accumulating stage.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊暫停對外發布，把三個月的時間放在補技術債上。大畜描述的是這種先積起來的結構，不是說之後一定做得更快。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a team pauses external releases and spends three months paying down technical debt. Da Xu describes that structure of accumulating first; it does not say the team later moves faster.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：艮移到下面、乾移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Gen moves down and Qian moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 大畜和小畜的差別是什麼？
prompt.en: What is the difference between Da Xu and Xiao Xu?

text.zh-Hant: 大畜是整組艮在上面擋，小畜只有一條陰爻
text.en: Da Xu is restrained by a whole Gen above; Xiao Xu by a single yin line

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。攔的份量不同，所以蓄的份量也不同。
explanation.en: Correct. The weight of the restraint differs, and so does what accumulates.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦的下卦都是乾。
explanation.en: Both have Qian as the lower trigram.

text.en: Da Xu has no yin lines

explanation.zh-Hant: 大畜的第四、第五爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The fourth and fifth lines of Da Xu are broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 這裡的「畜」是什麼意思？
prompt.en: What does xu mean here?

text.zh-Hant: 累積，力量暫時不往外走
text.en: Accumulating: the force is not going outward for now

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。被止住不等於消失。
explanation.en: Correct. Being held is not the same as being gone.

explanation.zh-Hant: 下卦乾三爻全實，力量沒有減少。
explanation.en: The lower Qian is entirely solid; nothing has been reduced.

explanation.zh-Hant: 在卦名裡它取的是蓄積的意思。
explanation.en: In the hexagram name it carries the sense of accumulating.

prompt.zh-Hant: 大畜的第六爻是陰還是陽？
prompt.en: Is the sixth line of Da Xu yin or yang?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。上卦艮的實線在最上面。
explanation.en: Correct. The solid line of the upper Gen is its topmost.

explanation.zh-Hant: 艮的最上面那爻是實線，斷線在第四、第五爻。
explanation.en: The top line of Gen is solid; its broken lines are the fourth and fifth.

explanation.zh-Hant: 一卦的每一爻都是固定的，大畜的第六爻是實線。
explanation.en: Every line of a hexagram is fixed; the sixth line of Da Xu is solid.

summary.zh-Hant: 上艮下震：實線只在最上與最下，中間四爻全是斷線。
summary.en: Gen above, Zhen below: solid lines only at the top and bottom, with four broken between.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出頤的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Yi (Nourishing).

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼這個圖像被讀成「口」。
objectives.en: Explain why this figure is read as a mouth.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，頤會變成小過。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns Nourishing into Small Exceeding.

structure.zh-Hant: 頤的下卦是震：初爻實線、上面兩爻斷線。上卦是艮：下兩爻斷線、第六爻實線。整卦只有第一與第六爻是實線，中間四爻都是斷線，上下各一條實線夾著一個空的中段。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Yi is Zhen: a solid first line with two broken above. The upper is Gen: two broken lines with a solid sixth. Only the first and sixth lines are solid; the four between them are broken, so two solid lines enclose an empty middle.

plain.zh-Hant: 上下兩條實線像上下顎，中間空著，所以這一卦被讀成「口」，談的是餵養與攝取。它關心的不是吃多少，而是進來的東西從哪裡來、由誰決定。結構上動的在下、止的在上，所以要自己動才拿得到，不是等著被餵。
plain.en: The two solid lines read as upper and lower jaws with a gap between, so this hexagram is taken as a mouth and concerns nourishment. Its question is not how much is taken in but where it comes from and who decides. Structurally movement is below and stopping above, so what is needed must be gone after rather than waited for.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個人決定自己挑學習材料，而不是等公司排課。頤描述的是這種自己決定攝取來源的結構，不是說這樣學得比較快。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: someone decides to choose their own learning material instead of waiting for the company to schedule training. Yi describes that structure of choosing one's own intake; it does not say they learn faster.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：艮移到下面、震移到上面，看看那兩條實線跑到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Gen moves down and Zhen moves up, and see where the two solid lines land.

prompt.zh-Hant: 頤的實線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Yi are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。中間四爻都是斷線，上下各一條實線。
explanation.en: Correct. The four middle lines are broken, with one solid line at each end.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻在交界處，頤的第三與第四爻都是斷線。
explanation.en: Those are the seam lines; in Yi both are broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那是兩個三爻卦的中間，頤的這兩爻都是斷線。
explanation.en: Those are the middles of the trigrams; in Yi both are broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼頤的圖像被讀成「口」？
prompt.en: Why is the figure of Yi read as a mouth?

text.zh-Hant: 上下各一條實線像上下顎，中間是空的
text.en: A solid line at each end reads as jaws, with a gap between

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。這是從排列看出來的圖像，不是卦名的字面意思。
explanation.en: Correct. The image comes from the arrangement, not from the literal name.

text.en: Because the name contains the character for mouth

explanation.zh-Hant: 圖像來自爻的排列，不是字形。
explanation.en: The image comes from the arrangement of lines, not from the character's shape.

text.en: Because the upper trigram is Li

explanation.zh-Hant: 頤的上卦是艮。
explanation.en: The upper trigram of Yi is Gen.

prompt.zh-Hant: 頤的結構暗示拿到東西的方式是什麼？
prompt.en: What does the structure of Yi suggest about how things are obtained?

text.en: Movement is below: one has to go after it

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦震是動，上卦艮是止。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower Zhen is movement and the upper Gen is stopping.

text.en: Waiting to be fed is enough

explanation.zh-Hant: 動的那一爻在下卦，不是在上面。
explanation.en: The moving line is in the lower trigram, not above.

text.en: It is entirely decided from above

explanation.zh-Hant: 上卦是止，不是給。
explanation.en: The upper trigram stops; it does not give.

summary.zh-Hant: 上兌下巽：中間四爻全是實線，上下兩端卻是斷線。
summary.en: Dui above, Xun below: four solid lines in the middle, broken at both ends.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出大過的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Da Guo.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼「中間重、兩端弱」讀成過。
objectives.en: Explain why heavy in the middle and weak at the ends reads as exceeding.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出大過的上下卦交換之後是中孚。
objectives.en: Work out that Great Exceeding with its halves swapped is Inner Truth.

structure.zh-Hant: 大過的下卦是巽：初爻斷線、第二與第三爻實線。上卦是兌：第四與第五爻實線、第六爻斷線。整卦第二到第五爻都是實線，只有頭尾兩爻是斷線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Da Guo is Xun: a broken first line with two solid above. The upper is Dui: two solid lines with a broken sixth. Lines two through five are solid; only the first and last are broken.

plain.zh-Hant: 份量全集中在中段，支撐的兩端卻是柔的。這個比例被讀成「過」：不是做錯，而是超出了結構承受的範圍。它和頤剛好相反——頤是中空，大過是中實。要注意「過」描述的是比例失衡，不是道德評價。
plain.en: The weight is all in the middle while the supporting ends are yielding. That proportion reads as exceeding: not wrongdoing, but going beyond what the structure can bear. It is the inverse of Yi — Yi is hollow in the middle, Da Guo is full there. Note that “exceeding” describes imbalance, not a moral judgement.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個專案把幾乎所有資源壓在中段的開發上，前期調研與後期維護都只有一個人。大過描述的是這種兩端太薄的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a project puts almost all its resources into the middle build phase, leaving one person each for discovery and maintenance. Da Guo describes that structure of thin ends.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：兌移到下面、巽移到上面，看看卦名與兩端的爻怎麼變。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Dui moves down and Xun moves up, and watch the name and the end lines change.

prompt.zh-Hant: 大過的斷線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Da Guo are broken?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。中間四爻都是實線。
explanation.en: Correct. The four middle lines are all solid.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻是實線，各在一個三爻卦的中間。
explanation.en: Those two are solid, each at the middle of a trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻也是實線。
explanation.en: Those two are solid as well.

prompt.zh-Hant: 大過和頤的關係是什麼？
prompt.en: How are Da Guo and Yi related?

text.zh-Hant: 一個中間實、一個中間空，每一爻剛好相反
text.en: One is full in the middle and the other hollow; every line is reversed

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。頤是上下實、中間空；大過是中間實、上下空。
explanation.en: Correct. Yi is solid at the ends and hollow between; Da Guo is the reverse.

explanation.zh-Hant: 頤交換上下卦得到小過，不是大過。
explanation.en: Swapping the halves of Yi gives Xiao Guo, not Da Guo.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦六爻全部相反。
explanation.en: All six lines are reversed.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「過」在這一卦指的是什麼？
prompt.en: What does “exceeding” mean in this hexagram?

text.zh-Hant: 比例失衡，超出結構能承受的範圍
text.en: Imbalance: going beyond what the structure can bear

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。它不是道德評價。
explanation.en: Correct. It is not a moral judgement.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦講的是結構的比例，不是對錯。
explanation.en: The hexagram speaks of proportion, not right and wrong.

explanation.zh-Hant: 這裡的過是超過，不是過去。
explanation.en: Here “guo” means exceeding, not past.

summary.zh-Hant: 上下都是坎：兩個坑疊起來，整卦只有兩條實線，各在一個三爻卦的中間。
summary.en: Kan upon Kan: two pits stacked, with only two solid lines, each centred in its trigram.

objectives.zh-Hant: 認出上下卦都是坎的那一卦。
objectives.en: Recognise the hexagram whose two halves are both Kan.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼坎不能用交換上下卦來觀察。
objectives.en: Explain why Kan cannot be observed by swapping halves.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出把坎的初爻翻面會得到節。
objectives.en: Work out that The Repeating Pit with its first line flipped is Limitation.

structure.zh-Hant: 坎的下卦與上卦都是坎：每一組都是上下斷線、中間實線。整卦的實線在第二與第五爻，其餘四爻是斷線。因為上下兩半相同，交換位置得到的還是坎，所以這一卦要用翻面一爻來看變化。
structure.en: Both halves of Kan are Kan: in each, the outer lines are broken and the middle one solid. The solid lines of the figure are the second and fifth; the other four are broken. Because the halves are identical, swapping them returns the same figure, so this hexagram is studied by flipping a single line.

plain.zh-Hant: 坎是坑、是水、是被圍住。兩個坎疊起來，講的是一個險之後接著另一個險。重點不在於險有多大，而在實線的位置：每一組的中間都有一條實線，意思是即使被圍住，中間仍有一個站得住的點。傳統在這一卦特別強調守中，根據就是這兩爻。
plain.en: Kan is a pit, water, being enclosed. Two Kan stacked describe one danger followed by another. What matters is not how great the danger is but where the solid lines sit: each half has one at its centre, which says that even when enclosed there is still a point that holds. Tradition stresses holding the centre here, and these two lines are the reason.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一件事剛解決一個阻礙，立刻遇到下一個，但核心的判斷標準一直沒有動搖。坎描述的是這種結構，不是說最後會脫困。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: one obstacle is cleared and the next appears at once, yet the core criterion for judgement has never wavered. Kan describes that structure; it does not say the way out is found.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把最下面那一爻翻成陽，看看卦名與下卦怎麼變。只有這一爻動。
instruction.en: Flip the bottom line to yang and watch the name and the lower trigram change. Only that line moves.

prompt.zh-Hant: 坎的實線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Kan are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。兩組坎各有一條實線在中間。
explanation.en: Correct. Each Kan has one solid line at its centre.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在每組最下面的是震疊震，那是第 51 卦。
explanation.en: Solid lines at the base of each half would be Zhen upon Zhen, hexagram 51.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在每組最上面的是艮疊艮，那是第 52 卦。
explanation.en: Solid lines at the top of each half would be Gen upon Gen, hexagram 52.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼坎不用交換上下卦來觀察？
prompt.en: Why is Kan not observed by swapping its halves?

text.zh-Hant: 上下卦都是坎，交換之後還是坎
text.en: Both halves are Kan, so swapping returns Kan

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。操作沒有任何變化，就教不到東西。
explanation.en: Correct. Nothing changes, so the operation teaches nothing.

explanation.zh-Hant: 任何一卦的任何一爻都可以翻面。
explanation.en: Any line of any hexagram can flip.

explanation.zh-Hant: 六十四卦都由兩個三爻卦組成。
explanation.en: All sixty-four hexagrams are built from two trigrams.

prompt.zh-Hant: 坎的初爻翻成陽，會變成哪一卦？
prompt.en: The first line of Kan flips to yang. Which hexagram results?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦從坎變成兌，上卦還是坎，那是第 60 卦節。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower trigram becomes Dui while the upper stays Kan, giving hexagram 60, Jie.

explanation.zh-Hant: 比是下坤上坎，下卦三爻全斷。
explanation.en: Bi is Kun below Kan, with three broken lines underneath.

explanation.zh-Hant: 井是下巽上坎，巽的斷線在最下面。
explanation.en: Jing is Xun below Kan, and Xun has its broken line at the bottom.

summary.zh-Hant: 上下都是離：兩組明疊起來，實線在兩端、斷線在兩組的中間。
summary.en: Li upon Li: two brightnesses stacked, solid at the ends of each half and broken at its centre.

objectives.zh-Hant: 認出上下卦都是離的那一卦。
objectives.en: Recognise the hexagram whose two halves are both Li.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出離與坎在結構上的關係。
objectives.en: State how Li and Kan are related structurally.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出離的初爻翻面之後會變成旅。
objectives.en: Say that flipping the first line of Clinging Brightness gives The Traveller.

structure.zh-Hant: 離的下卦與上卦都是離：每一組都是上下實線、中間斷線。整卦的斷線在第二與第五爻，其餘四爻是實線。它和坎逐爻相反，上下兩半也相同，所以同樣用翻面一爻來觀察。
structure.en: Both halves of Li are Li: in each, the outer lines are solid and the middle one broken. The broken lines of the figure are the second and fifth; the other four are solid. It is the line-by-line opposite of Kan, and its halves are likewise identical, so it too is studied by flipping one line.

plain.zh-Hant: 離是火、是明、是附著。兩組離疊起來，講的是光不斷接上去。有趣的是中間那兩爻是空的：看得清楚的結構，核心反而是柔的——光本身沒有實體，要附在別的東西上才燒得起來。傳統說離「麗」也說離「附」，就是這個意思。
plain.en: Li is fire, brightness, clinging. Two Li stacked describe light carried on and on. What is striking is that the two central lines are empty: in a structure of clear seeing, the core is yielding — light has no body of its own and must cling to something in order to burn. Tradition speaks of Li as both brilliance and attachment, and this is why.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一份講得很清楚的說明，之所以成立是因為底下有別人做好的資料。離描述的是這種依附在他物上的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: an explanation that lands clearly does so because someone else's data sits underneath it. Li describes that structure of depending on something else.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把最下面那一爻翻成陰，看看下卦從離變成什麼。
instruction.en: Flip the bottom line to yin and see what the lower trigram becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 離的斷線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Li are broken?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。兩組離各有一條斷線在中間。
explanation.en: Correct. Each Li has one broken line at its centre.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻是實線。斷線在兩端的是大過。
explanation.en: Those two are solid. Broken lines at both ends would be Da Guo.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻也是實線。
explanation.en: Those two are solid as well.

prompt.zh-Hant: 離和坎的關係是什麼？
prompt.en: How are Li and Kan related?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。坎是上下斷、中間實；離是上下實、中間斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Kan is broken outside and solid inside; Li is the reverse.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦的上下卦都和自己相同，交換不會變成另一卦。
explanation.en: Each has identical halves, so swapping cannot turn one into the other.

text.en: They differ only at the second line

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦六爻全部相反。
explanation.en: All six lines are reversed.

prompt.zh-Hant: 離的初爻翻成陰，會變成哪一卦？
prompt.en: The first line of Li flips to yin. Which hexagram results?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦從離變成艮，上卦還是離，那是第 56 卦旅。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower trigram becomes Gen while the upper stays Li, giving hexagram 56, Lü.

explanation.zh-Hant: 晉是下坤上離，下卦三爻全斷。
explanation.en: Jin is Kun below Li, with three broken lines underneath.

explanation.zh-Hant: 鼎是下巽上離，巽的斷線在最下面、上面兩爻是實線。
explanation.en: Ding is Xun below Li; Xun is broken at the bottom and solid above.

summary.zh-Hant: 上兌下艮：山在下、澤在上，兩邊互相感應的結構。
summary.en: Dui above, Gen below: a mountain beneath a lake — two sides affecting each other.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出咸的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Xian.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼這個排列讀成相互感應。
objectives.en: Explain why this arrangement reads as mutual influence.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出咸的上下卦交換之後是損。
objectives.en: Work out that Mutual Influence with its halves swapped is Decrease.

structure.zh-Hant: 咸的下卦是艮：初爻與第二爻斷線、第三爻實線。上卦是兌：第四與第五爻實線、第六爻斷線。整卦第三、第四、第五爻是實線。兩個三爻卦的實線剛好在交界兩側相鄰。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Xian is Gen: two broken lines with a solid third. The upper is Dui: two solid lines with a broken sixth. The third, fourth and fifth lines are solid, so the solid lines of the two trigrams meet on either side of the seam.

plain.zh-Hant: 艮是止、兌是悅。止的那一端在下面不動，悅的那一端在上面回應，兩組的實線在交界處貼著，於是整卦讀成感應：一邊不動，另一邊仍然被影響。這一卦常被用來談關係，但它描述的是互相作用的結構，不是關係的結果。
plain.en: Gen is stopping and Dui is pleasure. The stopping end holds still below while the responsive end answers above, and the solid lines of the two halves sit adjacent across the seam, so the figure reads as mutual influence: one side does not move and the other is affected all the same. The hexagram is often used to discuss relationships, but it describes a structure of interaction, not its outcome.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個人只是把事情做好、沒有說服任何人，旁邊的同事卻跟著改變做法。咸描述的是這種互相影響的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: someone simply does their work well and persuades nobody, yet a colleague alongside changes how they work. Xian describes that structure of mutual influence.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：兌移到下面、艮移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Dui moves down and Gen moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 咸的實線在哪三爻？
prompt.en: Which three lines of Xian are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦艮的實線在第三爻，上卦兌的實線在第四與第五爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower Gen is solid at the third line and the upper Dui at the fourth and fifth.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那會是下卦乾。咸的初爻與第二爻是斷線。
explanation.en: That would be a lower Qian; in Xian the first two lines are broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第六爻是斷線，上卦是兌不是乾。
explanation.en: The sixth line is broken, so the upper trigram is Dui, not Qian.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼咸讀成相互感應？
prompt.en: Why does Xian read as mutual influence?

text.zh-Hant: 下面止著不動，上面仍然被影響
text.en: What is below holds still and what is above is affected anyway

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。兩組的實線在交界兩側相鄰。
explanation.en: Correct. The solid lines of the halves sit adjacent across the seam.

explanation.zh-Hant: 下卦艮是止，不是動。
explanation.en: The lower Gen is stopping, not moving.

explanation.zh-Hant: 咸由艮與兌組成，沒有離。
explanation.en: Xian is built from Gen and Dui; there is no Li.

prompt.zh-Hant: 咸的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Xian?

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻實、第五爻實、第六爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Solid, solid, broken from the fourth line up.

text.en: Gen (two broken below, one solid on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 艮在咸裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Xian, Gen is the lower trigram.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 巽的斷線在最下面，咸的上卦斷線在最上面。
explanation.en: Xun is broken at the bottom; the upper trigram of Xian is broken at the top.

summary.zh-Hant: 上震下巽：風在下、雷在上，撐得久的那個結構。
summary.en: Zhen above, Xun below: wind underneath, thunder above — a structure that lasts.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出恆的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Heng.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼這個排列讀成持久。
objectives.en: Explain why this arrangement reads as duration.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出恆與益用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Duration and Increase use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 恆的下卦是巽：初爻斷線、第二與第三爻實線。上卦是震：第四爻實線、第五與第六爻斷線。整卦第二、第三、第四爻是實線，三條相連。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Heng is Xun: a broken first line with two solid above. The upper is Zhen: a solid fourth line with two broken above. The second, third and fourth lines are solid, forming a run of three.

plain.zh-Hant: 巽是風、是順著進；震是雷、是動。順在下、動在上，動得起來又不會斷，所以讀成持久。要注意「恆」不是不變：卦裡動的部分一直在，持久講的是能一直維持那個動作，不是停在原地。能長久的往往是能持續的小動作，不是一次用盡的大動作。
plain.en: Xun is wind, entering by going along; Zhen is thunder, movement. With yielding below and movement above, motion is sustained rather than broken, so the figure reads as duration. Note that heng does not mean unchanging: the moving part is always present, and duration means being able to keep that motion going, not standing still. What lasts is usually a small action that can be repeated, not one that spends everything at once.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊把每週固定一小時的整理排進行程，兩年沒停過。恆描述的是這種可以持續的結構，不是說結果一定好。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a team schedules one fixed hour of clean-up each week and keeps it for two years. Heng describes that sustainable structure; it does not say the results are good.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：震移到下面、巽移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Zhen moves down and Xun moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 恆的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Heng?

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻斷、第二爻實、第三爻實。
explanation.en: Correct. Broken, solid, solid from the bottom.

text.en: Zhen (one solid below, two broken above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 震在恆裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Heng, Zhen is the upper trigram.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌的斷線在最上面，恆的下卦斷線在最下面。
explanation.en: Dui is broken at the top; the lower trigram of Heng is broken at the bottom.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「恆」在這一卦指的是什麼？
prompt.en: What does heng mean in this hexagram?

text.en: Being able to keep the motion going

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。卦裡動的部分一直在，不是停住不變。
explanation.en: Correct. The moving part is always present; this is not stillness.

explanation.zh-Hant: 上卦震是動，這一卦有動。
explanation.en: The upper Zhen is movement; this figure moves.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那正是不持久的做法。
explanation.en: That is precisely what does not last.

prompt.zh-Hant: 恆的實線在哪三爻？
prompt.en: Which three lines of Heng are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。三條實線相連，跨過上下卦的交界。
explanation.en: Correct. Three solid lines run together across the seam.

explanation.zh-Hant: 初爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The first line is broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第五與第六爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The fifth and sixth lines are broken.

summary.zh-Hant: 上乾下艮：整組乾在上，山在下止住，往後退的結構。
summary.en: Qian above, Gen below: a whole Qian above a stopping mountain — a structure of retreat.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出遯的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Dun.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼退不等於輸。
objectives.en: Explain why retreat is not the same as losing.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，遯會變成大畜。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns Retreat into Great Accumulating.

structure.zh-Hant: 遯的下卦是艮：初爻與第二爻斷線、第三爻實線。上卦是乾，三爻全實。整卦第三到第六爻是實線，底下兩爻是斷線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Dun is Gen: two broken lines with a solid third. The upper is Qian, all solid. Lines three through six are solid; the bottom two are broken.

plain.zh-Hant: 陰爻從下面長出兩條，上面還是整組乾。結構上讀成「退」：不是被打敗，而是看出底下的條件已經換了，所以把位置讓開。這一卦的重點在時機與方向——退是一個動作，要退到站得住的地方，不是潰散。
plain.en: Two yin lines have grown from below while a whole Qian still stands above. Structurally this reads as retreat: not defeat, but recognising that the conditions underneath have changed and giving up the position. The point here is timing and direction — retreat is an action, and it must end somewhere that holds; it is not a rout.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一位負責人發現支援的資源已經轉到別處，主動把專案縮回核心範圍。遯描述的是這種主動縮回的結構，不是說專案失敗。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a lead notices the supporting resources have moved elsewhere and deliberately pulls the project back to its core. Dun describes that structure of deliberate withdrawal; it does not say the project failed.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：乾移到下面、艮移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Qian moves down and Gen moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 遯的斷線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Dun are broken?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦艮的兩條斷線在最下面。
explanation.en: Correct. The two broken lines of the lower Gen are at the bottom.

explanation.zh-Hant: 上卦乾三爻全實。
explanation.en: The upper Qian is entirely solid.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻都是實線。
explanation.en: Both of those lines are solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼說遯的退不等於輸？
prompt.en: Why is the retreat in Dun not losing?

text.zh-Hant: 上面整組乾還在，退是看出底下條件變了
text.en: The whole Qian above is intact; the retreat recognises changed conditions below

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。退是一個動作，要退到站得住的地方。
explanation.en: Correct. Retreat is an action, and it must end somewhere that holds.

text.en: Because the figure has no yin lines

explanation.zh-Hant: 遯的初爻與第二爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The first and second lines of Dun are broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 遯的意思是退避，不是贏。
explanation.en: Dun means withdrawing, not winning.

prompt.zh-Hant: 遯的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Dun?

text.en: Gen (two broken below, one solid on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻斷、第二爻斷、第三爻實。
explanation.en: Correct. Broken, broken, solid from the bottom.

explanation.zh-Hant: 坤三爻全斷，遯的第三爻是實線。
explanation.en: Kun is all broken; the third line of Dun is solid.

explanation.zh-Hant: 乾在遯裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Dun, Qian is the upper trigram.

summary.zh-Hant: 上震下乾：四條實線從底下長上來，動在最上面。
summary.en: Zhen above, Qian below: four solid lines rising from the base, with movement on top.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出大壯的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Da Zhuang.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼它叫「大壯」。
objectives.en: Explain why it is called great strength.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出大壯的上下卦交換之後是无妄。
objectives.en: Work out that Great Strength with its halves swapped is Without Pretence.

structure.zh-Hant: 大壯的下卦是乾，三爻全實；上卦是震：第四爻實線、第五與第六爻斷線。整卦第一到第四爻是實線，上面兩爻是斷線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Da Zhuang is Qian, all solid; the upper is Zhen, with a solid fourth line and two broken above. Lines one through four are solid; the top two are broken.

plain.zh-Hant: 四條實線從下面一路長到第四爻，動的那一爻就在這一串的最上端。結構上讀成「壯」：份量已經夠，而且還在往上動。這一卦附帶的提醒也來自結構——實線都在下半，上面兩爻是柔的，所以壯的方向往上走時，上面接不接得住是另一回事。
plain.en: Four solid lines rise from the bottom to the fourth place, and the moving line sits at the top of that run. Structurally this reads as strength: the weight is already sufficient and still rising. The caution attached to this hexagram also comes from its structure — the solid lines are all in the lower part and the two above are yielding, so whether the top can carry that rising strength is a separate question.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個產品線的人力與預算都到位，正要擴大規模，但上游的審核流程還沒跟上。大壯描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a product line has its people and budget in place and is about to scale, while the approval process upstream has not caught up. Da Zhuang describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：震移到下面、乾移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Zhen moves down and Qian moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 大壯的實線在哪幾爻？
prompt.en: Which lines of Da Zhuang are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦乾三爻全實，再加上卦震的第四爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower Qian is all solid, plus the fourth line of the upper Zhen.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第四爻也是實線，那是上卦震的實線。
explanation.en: The fourth line is solid too; it is the solid line of the upper Zhen.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第五與第六爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The fifth and sixth lines are broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「大壯」的提醒從哪裡來？
prompt.en: Where does the caution in Da Zhuang come from?

text.zh-Hant: 實線都在下半，上面兩爻是柔的
text.en: The solid lines are all below, and the top two are yielding

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。壯往上走時，上面接不接得住是另一件事。
explanation.en: Correct. As the strength rises, whether the top can carry it is a separate question.

text.en: Because the figure has no moving line

explanation.zh-Hant: 動爻是擲出來的，和卦象本身不是同一件事。
explanation.en: Moving lines come from the casting; they are not part of the figure itself.

text.en: Because the upper trigram is Kan

explanation.zh-Hant: 大壯的上卦是震。
explanation.en: The upper trigram of Da Zhuang is Zhen.

prompt.zh-Hant: 大壯的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Da Zhuang?

text.en: Zhen (one solid below, two broken above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻實、第五爻斷、第六爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Solid, broken, broken from the fourth line up.

explanation.zh-Hant: 乾在大壯裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Da Zhuang, Qian is the lower trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第四爻是實線，上卦不是坤。
explanation.en: The fourth line is solid, so the upper trigram is not Kun.

summary.zh-Hant: 上離下坤：地在下、明在上，光升起來的結構。
summary.en: Li above, Kun below: earth beneath brightness — light rising.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出晉的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Jin.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼「明在上、地在下」讀成前進。
objectives.en: Explain why brightness above earth reads as advance.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出晉與明夷用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Advance and Light Obscured use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 晉的下卦是坤，三爻全斷；上卦是離：第四爻實線、第五爻斷線、第六爻實線。整卦只有第四與第六爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Jin is Kun, all broken; the upper is Li: solid, broken, solid. Only the fourth and sixth lines of the figure are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 坤是地、離是明。光在地面上方，而且越升越高，所以這一卦讀成前進。它和「有沒有實力」是兩件事：底下三爻全是陰，意思是推進靠的不是硬碰硬，而是被看見。這個結構提醒的是，被看見之後要跟得上，否則上升得快也站不穩。
plain.en: Kun is earth and Li is brightness. The light is above the ground and climbing, so this hexagram reads as advance. That is a separate matter from how much force is held: the three lines below are all yin, meaning the progress comes from being seen rather than from pushing. The caution in the structure is that visibility has to be matched by substance, or a quick rise will not hold.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個小組因為一次成功的展示被整個部門注意到，接著收到很多新任務。晉描述的是這種被看見而前進的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a team is noticed across the department after one successful demo and immediately receives many new requests. Jin describes that structure of advancing by being seen.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：離移到下面、坤移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Li moves down and Kun moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 晉的實線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Jin are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。上卦離是上下實、中間斷，所以實線在第四與第六爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The upper Li is solid, broken, solid, so its solid lines are the fourth and sixth.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第五爻是斷線，上卦是離不是兌。
explanation.en: The fifth line is broken, so the upper trigram is Li, not Dui.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第五爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The fifth line is broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 晉的前進靠的是什麼？
prompt.en: What does the advance in Jin rest on?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。底下三爻全陰，推進的力量不在下面。
explanation.en: Correct. The three lines below are all yin; the pushing force is not there.

text.en: The three lines below are all yang

explanation.zh-Hant: 晉的下卦是坤，三爻全陰。
explanation.en: The lower trigram of Jin is Kun, entirely yin.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦描述結構，不保證結果。
explanation.en: A hexagram describes structure, not outcome.

prompt.zh-Hant: 晉的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Jin?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻到第三爻都是斷線。
explanation.en: Correct. The first through third lines are all broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 離在晉裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Jin, Li is the upper trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 晉的第二爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The second line of Jin is broken.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坤下離：明被壓在地下，看得見的那一面被蓋住。
summary.en: Kun above, Li below: brightness pressed beneath the earth, its visible side covered.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出明夷的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Ming Yi.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出明夷與晉的對照。
objectives.en: Contrast Ming Yi with Jin.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，明夷會變成晉。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns Light Obscured into Advance.

structure.zh-Hant: 明夷的下卦是離：初爻實線、第二爻斷線、第三爻實線。上卦是坤，三爻全斷。整卦只有第一與第三爻是實線。它和晉用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，上下位置相反。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Ming Yi is Li: solid, broken, solid. The upper is Kun, all broken. Only the first and third lines are solid. It uses the same two trigrams as Jin with their positions reversed.

plain.zh-Hant: 離本來是光，被整組坤壓在下面，光還在但照不出去。這一卦談的是「明被傷」：能力沒有消失，表現的通道被蓋住。要注意它描述的是當下的位置關係，不是對人的評價，也不預告什麼時候會翻轉。
plain.en: Li is light, and with a whole Kun above it the light is still there but cannot shine out. This hexagram concerns brightness being injured: the capability has not gone, the channel for showing it is covered. Note that it describes a present arrangement, not a judgement about anyone, and it does not foretell when things turn.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一位做得很好的人所在的團隊不對外匯報，成果到不了會看見的人手上。明夷描述的是這種結構，不是說這個人不夠好。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: someone does strong work on a team that does not report outward, so the results never reach anyone who would notice. Ming Yi describes that structure; it does not say the person is lacking.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換，看看會回到哪一卦。同樣的坤與離，位置一換，讀法就反過來。
instruction.en: Swap the halves and see which hexagram you return to. The same Kun and Li in the other order read the other way round.

prompt.zh-Hant: 明夷和晉的關係是什麼？
prompt.en: How are Ming Yi and Jin related?

text.zh-Hant: 同樣的坤與離，上下位置相反
text.en: The same Kun and Li with their positions reversed

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。晉是下坤上離，明夷是下離上坤。
explanation.en: Correct. Jin is Kun below Li; Ming Yi is Li below Kun.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦差的是整組三爻的位置。
explanation.en: They differ by whole trigrams changing place.

text.en: Ming Yi is six yin lines

explanation.zh-Hant: 明夷的初爻與第三爻是實線。
explanation.en: The first and third lines of Ming Yi are solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「明夷」指的是什麼？
prompt.en: What does Ming Yi refer to?

text.en: The light is still there but cannot shine out

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。離在下卦，被整組坤蓋住。
explanation.en: Correct. Li is the lower trigram, covered by a whole Kun.

explanation.zh-Hant: 下卦離還在，兩條實線都還在。
explanation.en: The lower Li remains, with both of its solid lines.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦講的是位置關係，不是時間。
explanation.en: The hexagram speaks of arrangement, not time of day.

prompt.zh-Hant: 明夷的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Ming Yi?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四到第六爻都是斷線。
explanation.en: Correct. The fourth through sixth lines are all broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 離在明夷裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Ming Yi, Li is the lower trigram.

text.en: Gen (two broken below, one solid on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 明夷的第六爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The sixth line of Ming Yi is broken.

summary.zh-Hant: 上巽下離：明在下、風在上，由內往外走的結構。
summary.en: Xun above, Li below: brightness within, wind without — a structure that works outward.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出家人的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Jia Ren.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼它被用來談家。
objectives.en: Explain why it is used to discuss a household.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出家人的上下卦交換之後是鼎。
objectives.en: Work out that The Household with its halves swapped is The Cauldron.

structure.zh-Hant: 家人的下卦是離：初爻實線、第二爻斷線、第三爻實線。上卦是巽：第四爻斷線、第五與第六爻實線。整卦第一、第三、第五、第六爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Jia Ren is Li: solid, broken, solid. The upper is Xun: a broken fourth line with two solid above. The first, third, fifth and sixth lines are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 離在內、巽在外：裡面是明，外面是順著走。這一卦被用來談家，不是因為字面上有「家人」，而是因為這個結構講的是「先把裡面弄清楚，外面才順」。順序不能反：裡面不清楚，對外再怎麼順也只是遷就。
plain.en: Li is inside and Xun outside: brightness within, going along without. The hexagram is used for households not because of its name but because the structure says that things go smoothly outside only once they are clear inside. The order cannot be reversed: if the inside is unclear, outward smoothness is only accommodation.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊先把內部的分工與標準講清楚，對外溝通才變得容易。家人描述的是這種由內往外的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a team first settles its internal division of work and standards, and only then finds external communication easy. Jia Ren describes that structure working from inside out.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：巽移到下面、離移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Xun moves down and Li moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 家人的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Jia Ren?

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻斷、第五爻實、第六爻實。
explanation.en: Correct. Broken, solid, solid from the fourth line up.

explanation.zh-Hant: 離在家人裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Jia Ren, Li is the lower trigram.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌的斷線在最上面，這裡的斷線在第四爻。
explanation.en: Dui is broken at its top; here the broken line is the fourth.

prompt.zh-Hant: 家人這一卦講的順序是什麼？
prompt.en: What order does Jia Ren describe?

text.zh-Hant: 先把裡面弄清楚，外面才順
text.en: Clarity inside first, smoothness outside after

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。離在內、巽在外。
explanation.en: Correct. Li is within and Xun without.

text.zh-Hant: 先對外順，裡面自然會好
text.en: Smoothness outside first, and the inside follows

explanation.zh-Hant: 那是把上下卦讀反了。
explanation.en: That reverses the two halves.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦的結構有上下之分，讀卦由下往上。
explanation.en: The figure distinguishes below from above, and hexagrams read upward.

prompt.zh-Hant: 家人的斷線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Jia Ren are broken?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦離中間斷，上卦巽最下面斷。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower Li is broken in the middle and the upper Xun at its base.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻是實線。
explanation.en: Those two lines are solid.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻是實線。
explanation.en: Those two lines are solid.

summary.zh-Hant: 上離下兌：澤在下、火在上，兩邊往不同方向走。
summary.en: Li above, Dui below: a lake below fire — the two moving in different directions.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出睽的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Kui.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼這個排列讀成分歧。
objectives.en: Explain why this arrangement reads as divergence.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出睽與革用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Divergence and Change use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 睽的下卦是兌：初爻與第二爻實線、第三爻斷線。上卦是離：第四爻實線、第五爻斷線、第六爻實線。整卦第一、第二、第四、第六爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Kui is Dui: two solid lines with a broken third. The upper is Li: solid, broken, solid. The first, second, fourth and sixth lines are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 火往上、澤往下，兩個三爻卦的方向本來就相反。結構上讀成分歧：不是誰錯，而是兩邊的走向不同。這一卦不主張硬要統一，它指出的是，分歧的地方如果看清楚，仍然能在局部合作。
plain.en: Fire rises and a lake settles downward, so the two trigrams already point opposite ways. Structurally this reads as divergence: not that either side is wrong, but that they are heading differently. The hexagram does not argue for forced unity; it points out that where the divergence is clearly seen, partial cooperation remains possible.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：兩個部門的目標本來就不同，一邊要穩定、一邊要速度，於是每次排程都要重談。睽描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: two departments have genuinely different goals — one wants stability, the other speed — so every schedule has to be renegotiated. Kui describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：離移到下面、兌移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Li moves down and Dui moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 睽的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Kui?

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻實、第二爻實、第三爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Solid, solid, broken from the bottom.

explanation.zh-Hant: 離在睽裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Kui, Li is the upper trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 睽的第三爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The third line of Kui is broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 睽的分歧來自哪裡？
prompt.en: Where does the divergence in Kui come from?

text.zh-Hant: 火往上、澤往下，方向本來相反
text.en: Fire rises and the lake settles: the directions are already opposite

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。這是兩個三爻卦的性質，不是誰犯了錯。
explanation.en: Correct. That is the nature of the two trigrams, not anyone's mistake.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦描述方向不同，不評價對錯。
explanation.en: The hexagram describes different directions, not fault.

explanation.zh-Hant: 睽的上下卦是離與兌，不相同。
explanation.en: The halves of Kui are Li and Dui, which differ.

prompt.zh-Hant: 睽主張怎麼處理分歧？
prompt.en: What does Kui suggest about handling divergence?

text.zh-Hant: 看清楚分歧在哪，仍然可以局部合作
text.en: See clearly where it lies; partial cooperation remains possible

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。它不主張硬要統一。
explanation.en: Correct. It does not argue for forced unity.

text.zh-Hant: 一定要統一成一個方向
text.en: Everything must be unified into one direction

explanation.zh-Hant: 那不是這個結構說的事。
explanation.en: That is not what this structure says.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦仍有相鄰的實線，並非完全不能合作。
explanation.en: The figure still has adjacent solid lines; cooperation is not ruled out.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坎下艮：山在下、水在上，走不動的那個結構。
summary.en: Kan above, Gen below: a mountain beneath water — a structure that cannot move.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出蹇的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Jian (Obstruction).

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出蹇和屯的差別。
objectives.en: State how Jian differs from Zhun.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，蹇會變成蒙。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns Obstruction into Youthful Ignorance.

structure.zh-Hant: 蹇的下卦是艮：初爻與第二爻斷線、第三爻實線。上卦是坎：第四爻斷線、第五爻實線、第六爻斷線。整卦只有第三與第五爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Jian is Gen: two broken lines with a solid third. The upper is Kan: broken, solid, broken. Only the third and fifth lines of the figure are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 下面是止、上面是險：腳下走不動，前面又有坎。它和屯都講難，但難的地方不同——屯是已經動起來才遇險，蹇是根本動不了。分清楚這兩種，處理的方向就不一樣：一個要找路，一個要先讓腳能動。
plain.en: Stopping below, danger above: there is no movement underfoot and a pit ahead. Like Zhun it speaks of difficulty, but of a different kind — in Zhun motion has already started and then meets danger, whereas in Jian motion cannot start at all. Telling the two apart changes what to do: one needs a route, the other needs the feet freed first.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一件事卡在兩邊都沒有權限處理，想動的人動不了。蹇描述的是這種結構，不是說這件事沒救。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a task is stuck because neither side has the authority to act, so whoever wants to move cannot. Jian describes that structure; it does not say the task is hopeless.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：坎移到下面、艮移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Kan moves down and Gen moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 蹇和屯的差別是什麼？
prompt.en: What is the difference between Jian and Zhun?

text.zh-Hant: 屯是動了才遇險，蹇是根本動不了
text.en: In Zhun motion starts and meets danger; in Jian motion cannot start

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。屯的下卦是震（動），蹇的下卦是艮（止）。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower trigram of Zhun is Zhen (movement), that of Jian is Gen (stopping).

explanation.zh-Hant: 下卦不同：一個是震，一個是艮。
explanation.en: Their lower trigrams differ: Zhen versus Gen.

text.en: The upper trigram of Jian is not Kan

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦的上卦都是坎。
explanation.en: Both have Kan above.

prompt.zh-Hant: 蹇的實線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Jian are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦艮的實線在第三爻，上卦坎的實線在第五爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower Gen is solid at the third line and the upper Kan at the fifth.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻是斷線。
explanation.en: Those two lines are broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻也是斷線。
explanation.en: Those two are broken as well.

prompt.zh-Hant: 面對蹇這種結構，先處理什麼？
prompt.en: With a structure like Jian, what comes first?

text.zh-Hant: 先讓腳能動，而不是先找路
text.en: Freeing the feet, not finding a route

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦是止，動不了的時候找路也走不出去。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower trigram stops; with no movement possible, a route alone does not help.

explanation.zh-Hant: 上卦是坎，硬走不是這個結構的解法。
explanation.en: The upper trigram is Kan; forcing through is not what this structure suggests.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦描述結構，沒有說放棄。
explanation.en: The hexagram describes a structure; it does not counsel giving up.

summary.zh-Hant: 上震下坎：險在下、動在上，鬆開來的那個結構。
summary.en: Zhen above, Kan below: danger underneath, movement above — a structure of release.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出解的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Xie.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出解和屯的對照。
objectives.en: Contrast Xie with Zhun.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出解的上下卦交換之後是屯。
objectives.en: Work out that Release with its halves swapped is Difficult Beginning.

structure.zh-Hant: 解的下卦是坎：初爻斷線、第二爻實線、第三爻斷線。上卦是震：第四爻實線、第五與第六爻斷線。整卦只有第二與第四爻是實線。它和屯用同樣兩個三爻卦，位置相反。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Xie is Kan: broken, solid, broken. The upper is Zhen: a solid fourth line with two broken above. Only the second and fourth lines are solid. It uses the same two trigrams as Zhun, in the other order.

plain.zh-Hant: 屯是動在下、險在上，走著就撞牆；解把險放在下面、動放在上面，險已經在腳下，動的方向朝外，所以讀成鬆開。要注意「解」不是什麼都解決了，而是卡住的地方鬆了一格，能動了。能動之後怎麼走，是下一步的事。
plain.en: Zhun has movement below and danger above, so walking runs into a wall; Xie puts the danger below and the movement above, so the danger is already underfoot and the motion points outward — hence release. Note that xie does not mean everything is resolved, only that the stuck place has loosened by one notch and movement is possible. Where to go next is a separate question.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一件卡了半年的事，因為某個權限終於下放而能開始處理。解描述的是這種鬆開的結構，不是說後面都會順。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: something stalled for half a year becomes workable because one approval is finally delegated. Xie describes that loosening; it does not say the rest goes smoothly.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換，看看會回到哪一卦。
instruction.en: Swap the halves and see which hexagram you return to.

prompt.zh-Hant: 解的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Xie?

text.en: Zhen (one solid below, two broken above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻實、第五爻斷、第六爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Solid, broken, broken from the fourth line up.

explanation.zh-Hant: 坎在解裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Xie, Kan is the lower trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第四爻是實線，上卦不是坤。
explanation.en: The fourth line is solid, so the upper trigram is not Kun.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「解」指的是什麼？
prompt.en: What does xie refer to?

text.zh-Hant: 卡住的地方鬆了一格，能動了
text.en: The stuck place has loosened by one notch and can move

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。它不代表全部解決。
explanation.en: Correct. It does not mean everything is resolved.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦只說結構鬆開，沒說結果。
explanation.en: The figure says the structure has loosened, not what results.

explanation.zh-Hant: 在卦名裡它取的是鬆開的意思。
explanation.en: In the hexagram name it carries the sense of loosening.

prompt.zh-Hant: 解和屯的關係是什麼？
prompt.en: How are Xie and Zhun related?

text.zh-Hant: 同樣的坎與震，上下位置相反
text.en: The same Kan and Zhen with their positions reversed

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。屯是下震上坎，解是下坎上震。
explanation.en: Correct. Zhun is Zhen below Kan; Xie is Kan below Zhen.

text.en: Xie is Zhun with one line flipped

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦有四爻不同。
explanation.en: The two differ in four lines.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦用的是同樣兩個三爻卦。
explanation.en: They are built from the same two trigrams.

summary.zh-Hant: 上艮下兌：澤在下、山在上，往下減的結構。
summary.en: Gen above, Dui below: a lake beneath a mountain — a structure of decrease.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出損的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Sun.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼減少不等於損失。
objectives.en: Explain why decrease is not the same as loss.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出損與咸用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Decrease and Mutual Influence use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 損的下卦是兌：初爻與第二爻實線、第三爻斷線。上卦是艮：第四與第五爻斷線、第六爻實線。整卦第一、第二、第六爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Sun is Dui: two solid lines with a broken third. The upper is Gen: two broken lines with a solid sixth. The first, second and sixth lines are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 下面兩條實線、上面只剩一條，中間三爻是空的。結構上讀成「減」：把下面的份量讓出去一些。要注意這一卦的重點是「減去之後留下什麼」，不是損失本身。減得對，剩下的才站得住；減得不對，只是變少。
plain.en: Two solid lines below, one left above, and three empty lines between. Structurally this reads as decrease: some of the weight below is given up. The point of this hexagram is what remains after the reduction, not the loss itself. Reduce well and what is left can stand; reduce badly and there is simply less.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊把功能清單砍掉一半，只留真正有人用的那些。損描述的是這種結構，不是說砍了就一定更好。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a team cuts its feature list in half and keeps only what is genuinely used. Sun describes that structure; it does not say cutting makes things better.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：艮移到下面、兌移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Gen moves down and Dui moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 損的實線在哪三爻？
prompt.en: Which three lines of Sun are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦兌的兩條實線在最下面，上卦艮的實線在最上面。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower Dui is solid at the bottom two and the upper Gen at the top.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第三爻是斷線，下卦是兌不是乾。
explanation.en: The third line is broken, so the lower trigram is Dui, not Qian.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第四與第五爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The fourth and fifth lines are broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 損的重點是什麼？
prompt.en: What is the point of Sun?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。減得對，剩下的才站得住。
explanation.en: Correct. Reduce well and what is left can stand.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦的結構指向剩下的部分，不是失去的部分。
explanation.en: The structure points at what is left, not at what is gone.

text.en: A promise that more will come

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦不保證結果。
explanation.en: The hexagram promises no outcome.

prompt.zh-Hant: 損的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Sun?

text.en: Gen (two broken below, one solid on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻斷、第五爻斷、第六爻實。
explanation.en: Correct. Broken, broken, solid from the fourth line up.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌在損裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Sun, Dui is the lower trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第六爻是實線。
explanation.en: The sixth line is solid.

summary.zh-Hant: 上巽下震：動在下、風在上，往上加的結構。
summary.en: Xun above, Zhen below: movement underneath, wind above — a structure of increase.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出益的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Yi (Increase).

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出益和損只差第二爻與第五爻。
objectives.en: Say that Yi and Sun differ only at the second and fifth lines.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，益會變成恆。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns Increase into Duration.

structure.zh-Hant: 益的下卦是震：初爻實線、第二與第三爻斷線。上卦是巽：第四爻斷線、第五與第六爻實線。整卦第一、第五、第六爻是實線。它和損只差兩爻：損在第二爻是實線、第五爻是斷線，益剛好倒過來。把損整個卦上下顛倒，也會得到益。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Yi is Zhen: a solid first line with two broken above. The upper is Xun: a broken fourth line with two solid above. The first, fifth and sixth lines are solid. Yi and Sun differ at only two places: Sun is solid at the second line and broken at the fifth, and Yi is the other way round. Turning the whole Sun figure upside down also gives Yi.

plain.zh-Hant: 損是把下面的讓出去，益是把上面的補下來。這一卦的結構是動在下、順在上，所以加的東西不是硬塞進來的，而是順著原本的動作加上去。加對了會長，加錯了只是變重。損與益是減和增的一組對照，要一起讀；但它們不是每一爻都相反，只有第二爻與第五爻不同。
plain.en: Sun gives up what is below; Yi brings down what is above. Here movement is below and yielding above, so what is added is not forced in but laid along the motion already there. Added well it grows; added badly it only weighs more. Sun and Yi are a pair about decrease and increase and are read together — but they are not opposites line by line: only the second and fifth lines differ.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個已經在跑的流程加上一個自動檢查，而不是再開一條新流程。益描述的是這種順著加上去的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: an automated check is added to a process already running, rather than starting a second process. Yi describes that structure of adding along the grain.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：巽移到下面、震移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Xun moves down and Zhen moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把損整個卦上下顛倒，會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Turn the whole Sun figure upside down. Which hexagram do you get?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。損由下而上是實、實、斷、斷、斷、實；整串倒過來讀就是實、斷、斷、斷、實、實，正好是益。
explanation.en: Correct. Sun from the bottom up is solid, solid, broken, broken, broken, solid; read the whole string backwards and it becomes solid, broken, broken, broken, solid, solid — which is Yi.

explanation.zh-Hant: 咸是把損的每一爻都翻面得到的，也等於把損的上下卦交換，和上下顛倒不是同一件事。
explanation.en: Xian is what you get by flipping every line of Sun, which here also equals swapping its halves. Turning the figure upside down is a different operation.

explanation.zh-Hant: 恆是益交換上下卦的結果，和損怎麼顛倒無關。
explanation.en: Heng is what Yi becomes when its halves are swapped; it has nothing to do with turning Sun around.

prompt.zh-Hant: 益的「加」是怎麼加的？
prompt.en: How does Yi add?

text.zh-Hant: 順著原本的動作加上去

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。動在下、順在上，加的東西沿著原本的方向走。
explanation.en: Correct. Movement below and yielding above: what is added runs along the direction already set.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那不是這個結構的讀法。
explanation.en: That is not how this structure reads.

explanation.zh-Hant: 加錯了只是變重，卦不保證結果。
explanation.en: Added badly it only weighs more; the hexagram promises no outcome.

prompt.zh-Hant: 益的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Yi?

text.en: Zhen (one solid below, two broken above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻實、第二爻斷、第三爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Solid, broken, broken from the bottom.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 巽在益裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Yi, Xun is the upper trigram.

text.en: Gen (two broken below, one solid on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 艮的實線在最上面，益的下卦實線在最下面。
explanation.en: Gen has its solid line on top; the lower trigram of Yi has it at the bottom.

summary.zh-Hant: 上兌下乾：五條實線往上長，只剩最上面那一爻是斷的。
summary.en: Dui above, Qian below: five solid lines rising, with only the topmost broken.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出夬的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Guai.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出那條斷線在最上面為什麼關鍵。
objectives.en: Say why the broken line at the top is decisive.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出夬的上下卦交換之後是履。
objectives.en: Work out that Resolute Parting with its halves swapped is Treading.

structure.zh-Hant: 夬的下卦是乾，三爻全實；上卦是兌：第四與第五爻實線、第六爻斷線。整卦只有第六爻是斷線，底下五爻都是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Guai is Qian, all solid; the upper is Dui, solid at the fourth and fifth and broken at the sixth. Only the sixth line is broken; the five beneath are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 五條實線已經推到第五爻，剩下最上面一條陰爻。結構上讀成「決」：差一步就清掉了，而最後那一步最容易出事，因為前面的力量太足。這一卦附帶的提醒都在這裡——快要完成的時候，急著收尾比阻力本身更危險。
plain.en: Five solid lines have pushed up to the fifth place, leaving one yin line at the top. Structurally this reads as resolute parting: one step from clearing it, and that last step is where things go wrong, precisely because the force behind is so complete. The cautions attached to this hexagram all live here — near the end, rushing to finish is more dangerous than the remaining resistance.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一件事只剩最後一個簽核，前面都通過了，這時候最容易因為趕而漏掉檢查。夬描述的是這個結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: only the final sign-off remains and everything before it has passed; this is exactly when a check is skipped out of haste. Guai describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：兌移到下面、乾移到上面，看看那條斷線跑到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Dui moves down and Qian moves up, and see where the broken line goes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 夬唯一的斷線在第幾爻？
prompt.en: Which is the only broken line in Guai?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。上卦兌的斷線在最上面。
explanation.en: Correct. The broken line of the upper Dui is its topmost.

explanation.zh-Hant: 斷線在第四爻、其餘全實的是小畜。
explanation.en: A broken fourth line with the rest solid would be Xiao Xu.

explanation.zh-Hant: 斷線在初爻的是姤。
explanation.en: A broken first line would make Gou.

prompt.zh-Hant: 夬的提醒在哪裡？
prompt.en: Where does the caution in Guai lie?

text.zh-Hant: 快完成的時候，急著收尾比阻力更危險
text.en: Near the end, haste is more dangerous than the remaining resistance

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。前面五爻的力量太足，容易推過頭。
explanation.en: Correct. The five lines behind carry so much force that it is easy to overshoot.

text.en: Because the resistance is very strong

explanation.zh-Hant: 只剩一條陰爻，阻力並不大。
explanation.en: Only one yin line remains; the resistance is not great.

text.en: Because there is not enough force

explanation.zh-Hant: 底下五爻都是實線，力量很足。
explanation.en: The five lines below are solid; force is ample.

prompt.zh-Hant: 夬的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Guai?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻到第三爻都是實線。
explanation.en: Correct. The first through third lines are all solid.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌在夬裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Guai, Dui is the upper trigram.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 夬的初爻是實線。
explanation.en: The first line of Guai is solid.

summary.zh-Hant: 上乾下巽：一條陰爻剛從最底下進來，上面五爻都是實線。
summary.en: Qian above, Xun below: one yin line has just entered at the bottom, with five solid lines above.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出姤的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Gou.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出姤和夬的對照。
objectives.en: Contrast Gou with Guai.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出姤與小畜用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Encountering and Small Restraint use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 姤的下卦是巽：初爻斷線、第二與第三爻實線。上卦是乾，三爻全實。整卦只有初爻是斷線。它也是乾的初爻翻面之後的那一卦。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Gou is Xun: a broken first line with two solid above. The upper is Qian, all solid. Only the first line of the figure is broken. It is also the hexagram you get by flipping the bottom line of Qian.

plain.zh-Hant: 夬是最上面剩一條陰，姤是最下面剛進一條陰。位置差很多：剛進來的那一條在底部，份量最小卻在地基上。這一卦談的是「遇到」——新的東西剛出現，還不足以改變上面，但它進來的位置最深。看得出來比看不出來重要。
plain.en: In Guai one yin line remains at the top; in Gou one has just entered at the bottom. The difference in position matters: the newcomer is at the base, smallest in quantity yet sitting in the foundation. This hexagram concerns encountering — something new has appeared, not yet enough to change what is above, but it has entered at the deepest point. Noticing it matters more than its size.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個系統剛出現一個低頻的錯誤，影響很小，但它發生在最底層的元件上。姤描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a system shows one rare error with little impact, but it occurs in the lowest-level component. Gou describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：乾移到下面、巽移到上面，看看那條斷線跑到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Qian moves down and Xun moves up, and see where the broken line goes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 姤和夬的對照是什麼？
prompt.en: How do Gou and Guai contrast?

text.zh-Hant: 夬的陰爻在最上面，姤的陰爻在最下面
text.en: Guai has its yin line at the top, Gou at the bottom

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。兩卦都是五實一斷，位置在兩端。
explanation.en: Correct. Both have five solid and one broken line, at opposite ends.

text.en: They have different numbers of yin lines

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦都只有一條斷線。
explanation.en: Each has exactly one broken line.

text.en: Gou is Guai with its halves swapped

explanation.zh-Hant: 夬交換上下卦得到履，不是姤。
explanation.en: Swapping the halves of Guai gives Lü, not Gou.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼姤的那條陰爻值得注意？
prompt.en: Why is the yin line of Gou worth noticing?

text.zh-Hant: 份量最小，但位置在地基上
text.en: It is smallest in quantity but sits in the foundation

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。它在初爻，整個結構的最底下。
explanation.en: Correct. It is the first line, the lowest point of the structure.

text.en: Because it will grow at once

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦象描述現在的排列，不預告下一步。
explanation.en: The figure describes the present arrangement, not the next step.

text.en: Because it is the sixth line

explanation.zh-Hant: 姤的第六爻是實線。
explanation.en: The sixth line of Gou is solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 乾的初爻翻面會得到哪一卦？
prompt.en: Flipping the first line of Qian gives which hexagram?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦從乾變成巽。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower trigram becomes Xun.

explanation.zh-Hant: 夬斷的是第六爻。
explanation.en: Guai has its broken line in the sixth position.

explanation.zh-Hant: 小畜斷的是第四爻。
explanation.en: Xiao Xu has its broken line in the fourth position.

summary.zh-Hant: 上兌下坤：地在下、澤在上，聚起來的結構。
summary.en: Dui above, Kun below: a lake over the earth — a structure of gathering.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出萃的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Cui.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼它是第八堂案例的之卦。
objectives.en: Say why it is the resulting hexagram in the lesson-eight example.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，萃會變成臨。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns Gathering into Approaching.

structure.zh-Hant: 萃的下卦是坤，三爻全斷；上卦是兌：第四與第五爻實線、第六爻斷線。整卦只有第四與第五爻是實線。第八堂的案例就是隨的初爻動，下卦從震變成坤，得到萃。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Cui is Kun, all broken; the upper is Dui, solid at the fourth and fifth and broken at the sixth. Only the fourth and fifth lines are solid. In the lesson-eight example the first line of Sui moves, its lower trigram becomes Kun, and the result is Cui.

plain.zh-Hant: 坤是地、是眾，兌是澤、是聚水的地方。水聚在地上，所以讀成聚集。結構上值得注意的是，兩條實線都在上面：聚起來的人很多，真正的著力點卻只有上面那兩爻。聚集本身不是成果，接下來怎麼用是另一件事。
plain.en: Kun is the earth and the many; Dui is a lake, a place where water collects. Water gathered on the ground reads as gathering. What is worth noting structurally is that both solid lines are above: many have gathered, but the real points of leverage are only those two upper lines. Gathering is not itself an achievement; what is done next is another matter.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一場說明會來了很多人，真正能決定事情的只有台上兩位。萃描述的是這種聚集的結構，不是說事情會談成。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: many people attend a briefing, and only the two on stage can actually decide anything. Cui describes that structure of gathering; it does not say agreement follows.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：兌移到下面、坤移到上面，看看那兩條實線跑到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Dui moves down and Kun moves up, and see where the two solid lines land.

prompt.zh-Hant: 萃的實線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Cui are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。上卦兌的兩條實線在下面兩爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The two solid lines of the upper Dui are its lower two.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在最下面兩爻的是臨。
explanation.en: Solid lines in the bottom two positions would be Lin.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第六爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The sixth line is broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 隨的初爻動，為什麼會得到萃？
prompt.en: Why does a moving first line in Sui give Cui?

text.zh-Hant: 初爻翻成陰，下卦從震變成坤
text.en: The first line flips to yin and the lower trigram becomes Kun

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。上卦兌不變，所以結果是下坤上兌的萃。
explanation.en: Correct. The upper Dui is unchanged, so the result is Kun below Dui: Cui.

explanation.zh-Hant: 動爻只翻一爻，不會搬動整組三爻。
explanation.en: A moving line flips one line; it does not move whole trigrams.

explanation.zh-Hant: 案例裡只有初爻是動爻。
explanation.en: In the example only the first line is moving.

prompt.zh-Hant: 萃的著力點在哪裡？
prompt.en: Where is the leverage in Cui?

text.en: In the two solid lines above

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。底下三爻全陰，實線都在上卦。
explanation.en: Correct. The three lines below are all yin; the solid lines are in the upper trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 底下三爻是整組坤，全是斷線。
explanation.en: The three below form a whole Kun, entirely broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第六爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The sixth line is broken.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坤下巽：風在地下，一層一層往上長的結構。
summary.en: Kun above, Xun below: wind beneath the earth — rising layer by layer.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出升的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Sheng.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出升和晉在結構上的差別。
objectives.en: State how Sheng differs from Jin.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出升的上下卦交換之後是觀。
objectives.en: Work out that Ascending with its halves swapped is Contemplating.

structure.zh-Hant: 升的下卦是巽：初爻斷線、第二與第三爻實線。上卦是坤，三爻全斷。整卦只有第二與第三爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Sheng is Xun: a broken first line with two solid above. The upper is Kun, all broken. Only the second and third lines of the figure are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 巽是順著進，坤是地。順著往上長，不是衝上去，所以讀成升。它和晉都講往上，差別在位置：晉的實線在上卦，是已經被看見；升的實線在下卦，是還在底下累積。要分清楚「正在長」和「已經到」。
plain.en: Xun enters by going along and Kun is the earth. Rising along the grain rather than bursting upward reads as ascending. Like Jin it speaks of going up, but the positions differ: the solid lines of Jin are in the upper trigram, already visible, while those of Sheng are below, still accumulating. Growing and having arrived are not the same.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個人把基礎工作做滿兩年，還沒有頭銜，但能做的事明顯變多。升描述的是這種還在底下長的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: someone spends two solid years on foundational work with no title to show, yet the range of what they can do has clearly widened. Sheng describes that structure of still growing below.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：坤移到下面、巽移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Kun moves down and Xun moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 升的實線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Sheng are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦巽的斷線在初爻，上面兩爻是實線。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower Xun is broken at the first line and solid in the two above.

explanation.zh-Hant: 上卦坤三爻全斷。
explanation.en: The upper Kun is entirely broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 初爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The first line is broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 升和晉的差別是什麼？
prompt.en: What is the difference between Sheng and Jin?

text.zh-Hant: 升的實線在下卦，晉的實線在上卦
text.en: Sheng has its solid lines below, Jin above

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。一個還在累積，一個已經被看見。
explanation.en: Correct. One is still accumulating, the other already visible.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦的上下卦都不同。
explanation.en: Both of their trigrams differ.

explanation.zh-Hant: 升的第二與第三爻是實線。
explanation.en: The second and third lines of Sheng are solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 升的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Sheng?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四到第六爻都是斷線。
explanation.en: Correct. The fourth through sixth lines are all broken.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 巽在升裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Sheng, Xun is the lower trigram.

text.en: Zhen (one solid below, two broken above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 第四爻是斷線，上卦不是震。
explanation.en: The fourth line is broken, so the upper trigram is not Zhen.

summary.zh-Hant: 上兌下坎：水在下、澤在上，被圍住的結構。
summary.en: Dui above, Kan below: water beneath a lake — a structure of confinement.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出困的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Kun (Confinement).

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出困和蹇的差別。
objectives.en: State how Kun (Confinement) differs from Jian.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出困與節用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Confinement and Limitation use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 困的下卦是坎：初爻斷線、第二爻實線、第三爻斷線。上卦是兌：第四與第五爻實線、第六爻斷線。整卦第二、第四、第五爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Kun is Kan: broken, solid, broken. The upper is Dui: two solid lines with a broken sixth. The second, fourth and fifth lines are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 坎在下是陷，兌在上是澤。水在底下走不出去，上面的澤看得到卻接不上，所以讀成困。它和蹇都講走不動，但困強調的是「資源就在旁邊卻用不到」。這種結構最容易被誤認為能力問題，其實是通道問題。
plain.en: Kan below is a pit and Dui above is a lake. The water underneath cannot get out, and the lake above is visible but not connected, so the figure reads as confinement. Like Jian it speaks of being unable to move, but Kun stresses resources that are right there yet unusable. This structure is easily mistaken for a lack of ability when it is a lack of a channel.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊看得到公司裡現成的工具，卻沒有申請的管道，只能自己重做。困描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a team can see that the company already has the tool it needs but has no route to request it, so it rebuilds one. Kun describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：兌移到下面、坎移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Dui moves down and Kan moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 困的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Kun (Confinement)?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻斷、第二爻實、第三爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Broken, solid, broken from the bottom.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌在困裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Kun, Dui is the upper trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 離和坎剛好相反，困的初爻是斷線。
explanation.en: Li is the reverse of Kan; the first line of Kun is broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 困強調的是什麼？
prompt.en: What does Kun (Confinement) stress?

text.zh-Hant: 資源就在旁邊卻用不到
text.en: Resources are right there and cannot be used

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。上面的澤看得到，底下的水接不上。
explanation.en: Correct. The lake above is visible and the water below cannot reach it.

text.en: That there are no resources at all

explanation.zh-Hant: 上卦兌有兩條實線，資源是存在的。
explanation.en: The upper Dui has two solid lines; the resources exist.

explanation.zh-Hant: 這是通道問題，不是能力問題。
explanation.en: This is a question of channels, not ability.

prompt.zh-Hant: 困和蹇的差別是什麼？
prompt.en: How does Kun differ from Jian?

text.zh-Hant: 蹇是腳下止住，困是通道不通
text.en: Jian is stopped underfoot; Kun has no channel

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。蹇的下卦是艮，困的下卦是坎。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower trigram of Jian is Gen; that of Kun is Kan.

text.en: They share the same lower trigram

explanation.zh-Hant: 蹇的下卦是艮，困的下卦是坎。
explanation.en: Jian has Gen below; Kun has Kan.

explanation.zh-Hant: 困有三條實線。
explanation.en: Kun has three solid lines.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坎下巽：木在水下，取之不盡的那個結構。
summary.en: Kan above, Xun below: wood beneath water — a structure that does not run dry.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出井的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Jing.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出井和困的對照。
objectives.en: Contrast Jing with Kun (Confinement).

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，井會變成渙。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns The Well into Dispersion.

structure.zh-Hant: 井的下卦是巽：初爻斷線、第二與第三爻實線。上卦是坎：第四爻斷線、第五爻實線、第六爻斷線。整卦第二、第三、第五爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Jing is Xun: a broken first line with two solid above. The upper is Kan: broken, solid, broken. The second, third and fifth lines are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 巽在下可以讀成木、讀成伸進去；坎在上是水。木伸進水裡把水取上來，就是井。井的特點是位置固定、水源不動，要用的人得自己走過去。結構上談的是「可靠但不會自己送上來」的資源，這和困剛好是一組對照。
plain.en: Xun below can be read as wood, as reaching in; Kan above is water. Wood reaching into water and drawing it up is a well. A well is fixed in place and the water does not move, so whoever needs it must come. Structurally this is about resources that are reliable but never delivered to you — the counterpart to Kun.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：公司有一份寫得很好的內部文件，一直都在，但只有主動去查的人用得到。井描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a company has one well-written internal document that has always been there, useful only to those who go and look. Jing describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：坎移到下面、巽移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Kan moves down and Xun moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 井的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Jing?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻斷、第五爻實、第六爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Broken, solid, broken from the fourth line up.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 巽在井裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Jing, Xun is the lower trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第五爻是實線。
explanation.en: The fifth line is solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 井這個結構說的是哪一種資源？
prompt.en: What kind of resource does Jing describe?

text.zh-Hant: 可靠，但不會自己送上來
text.en: Reliable, but never delivered to you

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。位置固定，要用的人得自己走過去。
explanation.en: Correct. It is fixed in place; whoever needs it must come.

explanation.zh-Hant: 井不會移動，這不是這個結構。
explanation.en: A well does not move; that is not this structure.

text.en: Always on the point of running dry

explanation.zh-Hant: 井談的是穩定的水源。
explanation.en: Jing speaks of a steady source.

prompt.zh-Hant: 井和困的對照是什麼？
prompt.en: How do Jing and Kun (Confinement) contrast?

text.zh-Hant: 困是看得到用不到，井是用得到但要自己去取
text.en: Kun is seeing without using; Jing is usable but must be fetched

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。兩卦都談資源與通道，方向相反。
explanation.en: Correct. Both concern resources and channels, in opposite directions.

text.en: They share the same upper trigram

explanation.zh-Hant: 困的上卦是兌，井的上卦是坎。
explanation.en: Kun has Dui above; Jing has Kan.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦都在講資源能不能用得到。
explanation.en: Both are about whether resources can be reached.

summary.zh-Hant: 上兌下離：火在下、澤在上，兩者相剋而生變。
summary.en: Dui above, Li below: fire beneath a lake — opposing elements producing change.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出革的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Ge.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼火與澤放在一起讀成改變。
objectives.en: Explain why fire and lake together read as change.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出革的上下卦交換之後是睽。
objectives.en: Work out that Change with its halves swapped is Divergence.

structure.zh-Hant: 革的下卦是離：初爻實線、第二爻斷線、第三爻實線。上卦是兌：第四與第五爻實線、第六爻斷線。整卦第一、第三、第四、第五爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Ge is Li: solid, broken, solid. The upper is Dui: two solid lines with a broken sixth. The first, third, fourth and fifth lines are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 火往上燒、水往下走，兩個放在一起不可能都保持原樣，所以這一卦讀成改變。它不是說改變一定好，而是說這個結構下維持原狀的成本比改變更高。要注意「革」是結構性的換法，不是修補。
plain.en: Fire burns upward and water runs down; placed together, neither can stay as it was, so this hexagram reads as change. It does not say change is good, but that in this structure keeping things as they are costs more than changing them. Note that ge means a structural replacement, not a patch.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個流程每次都要人工補救，維持的成本已經高過重新設計。革描述的是這種結構，不是說重做一定成功。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a process needs manual repair every time, and keeping it going now costs more than redesigning it. Ge describes that structure; it does not say the redesign succeeds.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：兌移到下面、離移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Dui moves down and Li moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 革的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Ge?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻實、第二爻斷、第三爻實。
explanation.en: Correct. Solid, broken, solid from the bottom.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌在革裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Ge, Dui is the upper trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 革的第二爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The second line of Ge is broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼火與澤放在一起讀成改變？
prompt.en: Why do fire and lake together read as change?

text.zh-Hant: 兩者不可能都維持原樣
text.en: Neither can remain as it was

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。這個結構下維持原狀的成本比改變高。
explanation.en: Correct. In this structure, keeping things unchanged costs more than changing.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦不評價好壞，只描述成本結構。
explanation.en: The hexagram does not judge; it describes the structure of costs.

text.en: Because the upper trigram is Zhen

explanation.zh-Hant: 革的上卦是兌。
explanation.en: The upper trigram of Ge is Dui.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「革」指的是哪一種改變？
prompt.en: What kind of change does ge mean?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。不是修補，是換掉原來的做法。
explanation.en: Correct. Not a patch, but replacing the way it was done.

explanation.zh-Hant: 修補不是這個字的意思。
explanation.en: Patching is not what the word means.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那和卦名相反。
explanation.en: That is the opposite of the name.

summary.zh-Hant: 上離下巽：木在火下，把生料變成熟食的結構。
summary.en: Li above, Xun below: wood beneath fire — turning raw material into something finished.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出鼎的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Ding.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出鼎與革為什麼常被一起讀。
objectives.en: Explain why Ding and Ge are often read together.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出鼎與家人用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
