objectives.en: Point out that The Cauldron and The Household use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 鼎的下卦是巽：初爻斷線、第二與第三爻實線。上卦是離：第四爻實線、第五爻斷線、第六爻實線。整卦第二、第三、第四、第六爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Ding is Xun: a broken first line with two solid above. The upper is Li: solid, broken, solid. The second, third, fourth and sixth lines are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 巽在下讀成木、離在上是火：木在火下，就是煮。鼎是器，談的是把原料變成可用的東西，需要容器、火候與時間。它常接在革後面讀：革是換掉舊的，鼎是把新的做成形。只拆不建，結構上不會停在革。
plain.en: Xun below reads as wood and Li above is fire: wood under fire is cooking. A ding is a vessel, and the hexagram concerns turning raw material into something usable, which takes a container, the right heat and time. It is often read after Ge: Ge replaces the old and Ding brings the new into shape. Tearing down without building does not stop at Ge structurally.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊把舊流程停掉之後，花三個月把新流程做成可以交接的文件與工具。鼎描述的是這種把東西做成形的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: after stopping the old process, a team spends three months turning the new one into documents and tools that can be handed over. Ding describes that structure of bringing something into shape.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：離移到下面、巽移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Li moves down and Xun moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 鼎的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Ding?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻實、第五爻斷、第六爻實。
explanation.en: Correct. Solid, broken, solid from the fourth line up.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 巽在鼎裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Ding, Xun is the lower trigram.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 鼎的第六爻是實線。
explanation.en: The sixth line of Ding is solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 鼎與革為什麼常被一起讀？
prompt.en: Why are Ding and Ge often read together?

text.zh-Hant: 革是換掉舊的，鼎是把新的做成形
text.en: Ge replaces the old; Ding brings the new into shape

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。只拆不建，結構上不會停在革。
explanation.en: Correct. Tearing down without building does not stop at Ge.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦的上卦不同：革是兌，鼎是離。
explanation.en: Their upper trigrams differ: Dui for Ge, Li for Ding.

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩卦都有兩條斷線。
explanation.en: Each has two broken lines.

prompt.zh-Hant: 鼎強調做成一件事需要什麼？
prompt.en: What does Ding stress is needed to finish something?

text.en: A container, the right heat and time

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。這是從「木在火下」這個圖像讀出來的。
explanation.en: Correct. That reading comes from the image of wood under fire.

explanation.zh-Hant: 沒有容器與時間，煮不成東西。
explanation.en: Without a vessel and time nothing is cooked.

explanation.zh-Hant: 下卦巽是要伸進去、要備料。
explanation.en: The lower Xun is reaching in, the preparing.

summary.zh-Hant: 上下都是震：兩個動疊起來，實線在每一組的最下面。
summary.en: Zhen upon Zhen: two movements stacked, each solid line at the base of its half.

objectives.zh-Hant: 認出上下卦都是震的那一卦。
objectives.en: Recognise the hexagram whose two halves are both Zhen.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出實線在每組最下面代表什麼。
objectives.en: Say what it means for each solid line to sit at the base of its half.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出把震的初爻翻面會得到豫。
objectives.en: Work out that Shock with its first line flipped is Enthusiasm.

structure.zh-Hant: 震的下卦與上卦都是震：每一組都是最下面一爻實線、上面兩爻斷線。整卦的實線在第一與第四爻，其餘四爻是斷線。上下兩半相同，所以交換位置看不出差別，要用翻面一爻來觀察。
structure.en: Both halves of Zhen are Zhen: in each, the lowest line is solid and the two above are broken. The solid lines of the figure are the first and fourth; the other four are broken. The halves are identical, so swapping shows nothing and a single line is flipped instead.

plain.zh-Hant: 震是雷、是震動。實線在每一組的最下面，意思是動從底部開始，而且發生了兩次。它被讀成驚動：事情從下面來，上面還沒反應。重點不在聲音大，而在位置——動的來源在基礎，所以整個結構都會被帶到。
plain.en: Zhen is thunder, a shaking. Each solid line sits at the base of its half, which says the movement starts from the bottom and happens twice. It is read as being startled: something comes from below before anything above has reacted. The point is not loudness but position — the source is in the foundation, so the whole structure is carried along.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個基礎元件改了介面，所有依賴它的服務都得跟著動。震描述的是這種從底部開始的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a foundational component changes its interface and every service depending on it has to move. Zhen describes that structure starting from the base.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把最下面那一爻翻成陰，看看下卦不再是震之後，卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Flip the bottom line to yin and see what the name becomes once the lower trigram is no longer Zhen.

prompt.zh-Hant: 震的實線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Zhen are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。兩組震各有一條實線在最下面。
explanation.en: Correct. Each Zhen has its solid line at the base.

explanation.zh-Hant: 實線在每組中間的是坎疊坎，那是第 29 卦。
explanation.en: Solid lines at the centre of each half would be Kan upon Kan, hexagram 29.

prompt.zh-Hant: 震的動從哪裡開始？
prompt.en: Where does the movement in Zhen begin?

text.zh-Hant: 從底部開始，而且發生兩次
text.en: At the base, and it happens twice

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。兩組的實線都在最下面。
explanation.en: Correct. Both solid lines sit at the base of their halves.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第六爻是斷線，動的不在上面。
explanation.en: The sixth line is broken; the movement is not above.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第二與第五爻都是斷線。
explanation.en: The second and fifth lines are both broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 震的初爻翻成陰，會變成哪一卦？
prompt.en: The first line of Zhen flips to yin. Which hexagram results?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦從震變成坤，上卦還是震，那是第 16 卦豫。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower trigram becomes Kun while the upper stays Zhen, giving hexagram 16, Yu.

explanation.zh-Hant: 復是下震上坤，上卦不是震。
explanation.en: Fu is Zhen below Kun; its upper trigram is not Zhen.

explanation.zh-Hant: 解是下坎上震，下卦不是坤。
explanation.en: Xie is Kan below Zhen; its lower trigram is not Kun.

summary.zh-Hant: 上下都是艮：兩個止疊起來，實線在每一組的最上面。
summary.en: Gen upon Gen: two stoppings stacked, each solid line at the top of its half.

objectives.zh-Hant: 認出上下卦都是艮的那一卦。
objectives.en: Recognise the hexagram whose two halves are both Gen.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出艮與震在結構上的關係。
objectives.en: State how Gen and Zhen are related structurally.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出艮的第三爻翻面之後會變成剝。
objectives.en: Say that flipping the third line of Stilling gives Stripping Away.

structure.zh-Hant: 艮的下卦與上卦都是艮：每一組都是下面兩爻斷線、最上面一爻實線。整卦的實線在第三與第六爻。它和震剛好是上下翻轉的排法：震的實線在每組底部，艮的實線在每組頂端。
structure.en: Both halves of Gen are Gen: in each, the lower two lines are broken and the top one is solid. The solid lines of the figure are the third and sixth. It is the vertical mirror of Zhen: Zhen has its solid lines at the base of each half, Gen at the top.

plain.zh-Hant: 艮是山、是止。實線在每一組的最上面，意思是停住的力量在頂端，底下是空的。它講的不是不動，而是「知道停在哪裡」。停在對的位置是結構，停錯了只是卡住——這一卦的全部難處都在這個差別上。
plain.en: Gen is a mountain, stopping. Each solid line sits at the top of its half, so the stopping force is at the summit with emptiness beneath. The hexagram is not about immobility but about knowing where to stop. Stopping in the right place is structure; stopping in the wrong one is merely being stuck — and the whole difficulty of this hexagram lies in that difference.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊決定這一版不再加功能，把界線畫在明確的地方。艮描述的是這種知道停在哪裡的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a team decides this release takes no more features and draws the line somewhere explicit. Gen describes that structure of knowing where to stop.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把第三爻翻成陰，看看下卦從艮變成什麼、卦名又變成什麼。
instruction.en: Flip the third line to yin and see what the lower trigram and the name become.

prompt.zh-Hant: 艮的實線在哪兩爻？

explanation.zh-Hant: 那是震疊震的排法。

explanation.en: That is the arrangement of Kan upon Kan.

prompt.zh-Hant: 艮講的是什麼？

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。停在對的位置是結構，停錯了只是卡住。
explanation.en: Correct. Stopping in the right place is structure; stopping wrongly is being stuck.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦講的是停的位置，不是不動本身。
explanation.en: The hexagram is about where one stops, not immobility itself.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那是震或乾的方向，不是艮。

summary.zh-Hant: 上巽下艮：山在下、風在上，一步一步來的結構。
summary.en: Xun above, Gen below: a mountain beneath wind — a structure of step by step.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出漸的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Jian (Gradual Progress).

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼「止在下、順在上」讀成漸進。
objectives.en: Explain why stopping below and yielding above reads as gradual.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出漸與蠱用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Gradual Progress and Repairing What Has Decayed use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 漸的下卦是艮：初爻與第二爻斷線、第三爻實線。上卦是巽：第四爻斷線、第五與第六爻實線。整卦第三、第五、第六爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Jian is Gen: two broken lines with a solid third. The upper is Xun: a broken fourth line with two solid above. The third, fifth and sixth lines are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 艮是止、巽是順著進。底下有界線、上面順著走，所以每一步都在界線之內往前，讀成漸。這一卦的價值在節奏：它不是慢，而是每一步都踩實了才走下一步。跳過步驟的進展在這個結構裡不算進展。
plain.en: Gen is stopping and Xun enters by going along. With a boundary below and yielding above, each step moves forward inside the boundary, which reads as gradual. The value here is cadence: not slowness, but not taking the next step until this one is firm. Progress that skips steps does not count as progress in this structure.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊每次只改一個模組，改完就驗，確認沒事才動下一個。漸描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a team changes one module at a time, verifies it, and only then touches the next. Jian describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：巽移到下面、艮移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Xun moves down and Gen moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 漸的「漸」重點是什麼？
prompt.en: What is the point of “gradual” in Jian?

explanation.zh-Hant: 慢不是重點，踩實才是。

explanation.zh-Hant: 跳過步驟在這個結構裡不算進展。

summary.zh-Hant: 上震下兌：悅在下、動在上，位置不對等的結構。
summary.en: Zhen above, Dui below: pleasure underneath, movement above — a structure of unequal positions.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出歸妹的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Gui Mei.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出歸妹和隨的對照。
objectives.en: Contrast Gui Mei with Sui.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，歸妹會變成隨。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns The Marrying Maiden into Following.

structure.zh-Hant: 歸妹的下卦是兌：初爻與第二爻實線、第三爻斷線。上卦是震：第四爻實線、第五與第六爻斷線。整卦第一、第二、第四爻是實線。它和隨用同樣兩個三爻卦，位置相反。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Gui Mei is Dui: two solid lines with a broken third. The upper is Zhen: a solid fourth line with two broken above. The first, second and fourth lines are solid. It uses the same two trigrams as Sui, in the other order.

plain.zh-Hant: 隨是動在下、悅在上，下面先動、上面願意跟；歸妹把悅放在下面、動放在上面，變成下面願意配合、上面自己在動。結構上讀成位置不對等：事情會成，但條件不是自己定的。傳統用婚嫁來談它，重點在「進入別人既有的安排」。
plain.en: In Sui movement is below and pleasure above: what is below moves first and what is above goes along. Gui Mei puts pleasure below and movement above, so the lower side accommodates while the upper moves on its own. Structurally this reads as unequal position: the thing may well happen, but not on terms you set. Tradition discusses it through marriage, and the point is entering an arrangement someone else already made.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個小團隊加入一個既有的大專案，規範與時程都是對方定的。歸妹描述的是這種結構，不是說合作會失敗。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a small team joins an existing large programme whose standards and schedule were set by others. Gui Mei describes that structure; it does not say the collaboration fails.

prompt.zh-Hant: 歸妹的結構說的是什麼？

text.zh-Hant: 事情會成，但條件不是自己定的
text.en: It may well happen, but not on terms you set

explanation.en: In Gui Mei, Dui is the lower trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第四爻是實線。
explanation.en: The fourth line is solid.

summary.zh-Hant: 上震下離：明在下、動在上，份量最足的時候。
summary.en: Zhen above, Li below: brightness underneath, movement above — the fullest moment.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出豐的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Feng.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼豐裡附帶的提醒和它的名字相反。
objectives.en: Explain why the caution in Feng runs against its name.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出豐的上下卦交換之後是噬嗑。
objectives.en: Work out that Abundance with its halves swapped is Biting Through.

structure.zh-Hant: 豐的下卦是離：初爻實線、第二爻斷線、第三爻實線。上卦是震：第四爻實線、第五與第六爻斷線。整卦第一、第三、第四爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Feng is Li: solid, broken, solid. The upper is Zhen: a solid fourth line with two broken above. The first, third and fourth lines are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 離是明、震是動：看得清又動得起來，所以讀成豐，也就是份量最足的那個階段。提醒也在結構裡：上面兩爻是斷線，最頂端沒有支撐。份量足的時候最容易忽略這件事，所以傳統在這一卦談的是日中則移，不是慶賀。
plain.en: Li is brightness and Zhen is movement: seeing clearly and being able to act reads as abundance, the fullest stage. The caution is in the structure too: the top two lines are broken, so the summit has no support. That is easy to ignore precisely when things are at their fullest, which is why tradition speaks here of the sun past noon rather than of celebration.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個部門正在最好的時候，案子接不完，但沒有人在看人力的上限。豐描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a department is at its peak with more work than it can take, and nobody is watching the limit on its people. Feng describes that structure.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出旅的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Lü (The Traveller).

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼它讀成旅。
objectives.en: Explain why it reads as travelling.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出旅與賁用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that The Traveller and Adornment use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 旅的下卦是艮：初爻與第二爻斷線、第三爻實線。上卦是離：第四爻實線、第五爻斷線、第六爻實線。整卦第三、第四、第六爻是實線。它也是離的初爻翻面之後的那一卦。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Lü is Gen: two broken lines with a solid third. The upper is Li: solid, broken, solid. The third, fourth and sixth lines are solid. It is also the hexagram you get by flipping the bottom line of Li.

plain.zh-Hant: 艮是山，不動；離是火，附在別的東西上才燒。火在山上，位置是暫時的，所以讀成旅。這一卦談的是「在別人的地方」：規則不是自己定的，能帶的東西有限，所以要分清楚哪些要帶、哪些要放下。
plain.en: Gen is a mountain, which does not move; Li is fire, which burns only by clinging to something else. Fire on a mountain is in a temporary place, so this reads as travelling. The hexagram concerns being somewhere that is not yours: the rules are not yours to set and only so much can be carried, so what to bring and what to leave must be told apart.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一位工程師被借調到另一個團隊三個月，用的是對方的工具與流程。旅描述的是這種暫時位置的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: an engineer is seconded to another team for three months and works with that team's tools and process. Lü describes that structure of a temporary position.

objectives.en: Explain why the force of Xun is at the very bottom.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出把巽的初爻翻面會得到小畜。
objectives.en: Work out that The Gentle with its first line flipped is Small Restraint.

structure.zh-Hant: 巽的下卦與上卦都是巽：每一組都是最下面一爻斷線、上面兩爻實線。整卦的斷線在第一與第四爻。上下兩半相同，所以這一卦也用翻面一爻來觀察。
structure.en: Both halves of Xun are Xun: in each, the lowest line is broken and the two above are solid. The broken lines of the figure are the first and fourth. The halves are identical, so this hexagram too is studied by flipping one line.

plain.zh-Hant: 巽是風，也是進入。斷線在每一組的最下面，意思是柔的那一端在底部——風不是從上面壓下來的，是從縫隙鑽進去的。這一卦談的是怎麼進入一個不歡迎你的地方：靠的不是力量，是找到最底下那個縫。
plain.en: Xun is wind, and also entering. Each broken line sits at the base of its half, so the yielding end is at the bottom — wind does not press down from above; it works in through a gap. This hexagram is about entering somewhere that does not welcome you: not by force, but by finding the gap at the very bottom.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個新做法先從一個願意試的小組開始，而不是先去說服主管。巽描述的是這種從底下進入的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a new practice starts with one team willing to try it rather than with persuading management. Xun describes that structure of entering from below.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把最下面那一爻翻成陽，看看下卦從巽變成什麼。
instruction.en: Flip the bottom line to yang and see what the lower trigram becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 巽的斷線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Xun are broken?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。兩組巽各有一條斷線在最下面。
explanation.en: Correct. Each Xun has its broken line at the base.

explanation.zh-Hant: 斷線在每組最上面的是兌疊兌，那是第 58 卦。
explanation.en: Broken lines at the top of each half would be Dui upon Dui, hexagram 58.

explanation.zh-Hant: 斷線在每組中間的是離疊離，那是第 30 卦。
explanation.en: Broken lines at the centre of each half would be Li upon Li, hexagram 30.

prompt.zh-Hant: 巽怎麼進入？
prompt.en: How does Xun enter?

text.zh-Hant: 從最底下的縫隙進去，不靠力量
text.en: Through the gap at the bottom, not by force

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。斷線在每組的最下面。
explanation.en: Correct. The broken line sits at the base of each half.

explanation.zh-Hant: 上面兩爻是實線，柔的那一端在底部。
explanation.en: The two upper lines are solid; the yielding end is at the base.

text.en: By cutting in at the middle

explanation.zh-Hant: 第二與第五爻都是實線。
explanation.en: The second and fifth lines are both solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 巽的初爻翻成陽，會變成哪一卦？
prompt.en: The first line of Xun flips to yang. Which hexagram results?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦從巽變成乾，上卦還是巽，那是第 9 卦小畜。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower trigram becomes Qian while the upper stays Xun, giving hexagram 9, Xiao Xu.

explanation.zh-Hant: 姤是下巽上乾，上卦不是巽。
explanation.en: Gou is Xun below Qian; its upper trigram is not Xun.

explanation.zh-Hant: 家人是下離上巽，下卦不是乾。
explanation.en: Jia Ren is Li below Xun; its lower trigram is not Qian.

summary.zh-Hant: 上下都是兌：兩個悅疊起來，斷線在每一組的最上面。
summary.en: Dui upon Dui: two pleasures stacked, each broken line at the top of its half.

objectives.zh-Hant: 認出上下卦都是兌的那一卦。
objectives.en: Recognise the hexagram whose two halves are both Dui.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出兌與巽在結構上的關係。
objectives.en: State how Dui and Xun are related structurally.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出兌的第三爻翻面之後會變成夬。
objectives.en: Say that flipping the third line of The Joyous gives Resolute Parting.

structure.zh-Hant: 兌的下卦與上卦都是兌：每一組都是下面兩爻實線、最上面一爻斷線。整卦的斷線在第三與第六爻。它和巽剛好是上下翻轉的排法：巽的斷線在每組底部，兌的斷線在每組頂端。
structure.en: Both halves of Dui are Dui: in each, the lower two lines are solid and the top one is broken. The broken lines of the figure are the third and sixth. It is the vertical mirror of Xun: Xun has its broken lines at the base of each half, Dui at the top.

plain.zh-Hant: 兌是澤、是悅、是說出來。斷線在每一組的最上面，意思是開口在頂端，底下是實的。這一卦讀成喜悅，但它的條件在結構裡：底下兩爻是實的，所以能說出來的前提是下面有東西。空的悅在這個結構裡站不住。
plain.en: Dui is a lake, pleasure, speaking out. Each broken line sits at the top of its half, so the opening is at the summit with solidity beneath. The hexagram reads as joy, and its condition is in the structure: the lower two lines are solid, so speaking out presupposes something underneath. Empty pleasure does not stand up here.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊願意公開講問題，因為底下的信任與紀錄都夠紮實。兌描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a team is willing to talk about problems openly because the trust and records underneath are solid. Dui describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把第三爻翻成陽，看看下卦從兌變成什麼、卦名又變成什麼。
instruction.en: Flip the third line to yang and see what the lower trigram and the name become.

prompt.zh-Hant: 兌的斷線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Dui are broken?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。兩組兌各有一條斷線在最上面。
explanation.en: Correct. Each Dui has its broken line at the top.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那是巽疊巽的排法。
explanation.en: That is the arrangement of Xun upon Xun.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那是離疊離的排法。
explanation.en: That is the arrangement of Li upon Li.

prompt.zh-Hant: 兌的喜悅有什麼條件？
prompt.en: What condition does the joy of Dui carry?

text.zh-Hant: 底下兩爻是實的，說得出來的前提是下面有東西
text.en: The lower two lines are solid: speaking out presupposes substance beneath

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。空的悅在這個結構裡站不住。
explanation.en: Correct. Empty pleasure does not stand up here.

explanation.zh-Hant: 底下兩爻是實線，那就是條件。
explanation.en: The two solid lines below are precisely the condition.

text.en: The three lines below are all broken

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌的下卦只有第三爻是斷線。
explanation.en: In the lower Dui only the third line is broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 兌的第三爻翻成陽，會變成哪一卦？
prompt.en: The third line of Dui flips to yang. Which hexagram results?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦從兌變成乾，上卦還是兌，那是第 43 卦夬。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower trigram becomes Qian while the upper stays Dui, giving hexagram 43, Guai.

explanation.zh-Hant: 履是下兌上乾，上卦不是兌。
explanation.en: Lü is Dui below Qian; its upper trigram is not Dui.

explanation.zh-Hant: 困是下坎上兌，那是初爻翻面的結果。
explanation.en: Kun is Kan below Dui, which comes from flipping the first line.

summary.zh-Hant: 上巽下坎：水在下、風在上，往外散開的結構。
summary.en: Xun above, Kan below: wind over water — a structure of dispersing.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出渙的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Huan.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼「風吹在水上」讀成散。
objectives.en: Explain why wind over water reads as dispersion.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出渙與井用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Dispersion and The Well use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 渙的下卦是坎：初爻斷線、第二爻實線、第三爻斷線。上卦是巽：第四爻斷線、第五與第六爻實線。整卦第二、第五、第六爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Huan is Kan: broken, solid, broken. The upper is Xun: a broken fourth line with two solid above. The second, fifth and sixth lines are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 坎是水、巽是風。風吹在水面上，水就散開，所以讀成渙。散不一定是壞事：聚在一處的東西如果堵住了，散開反而通了。這一卦的判斷點在於散開之後有沒有重新聚的地方——散而無歸，才是真的失去。
plain.en: Kan is water and Xun is wind. Wind over the surface scatters the water, so the figure reads as dispersion. Scattering is not necessarily bad: if what has collected in one place is blocked, dispersing opens it. The question in this hexagram is whether there is somewhere to regather afterwards — scattering with nowhere to return is the real loss.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個過度集中的團隊被拆成幾個小組，溝通反而變快，前提是還有共同的紀錄可以匯整。渙描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: an over-centralised team is split into smaller groups and communication actually speeds up — provided a shared record still exists to gather into. Huan describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：巽移到下面、坎移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Xun moves down and Kan moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 渙的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Huan?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻斷、第二爻實、第三爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Broken, solid, broken from the bottom.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 巽在渙裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Huan, Xun is the upper trigram.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 渙的初爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The first line of Huan is broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 渙的判斷點在哪裡？
prompt.en: What is the deciding question in Huan?

text.zh-Hant: 散開之後有沒有重新聚的地方
text.en: Whether there is somewhere to regather afterwards

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。散而無歸才是真的失去。
explanation.en: Correct. Scattering with nowhere to return is the real loss.

explanation.zh-Hant: 堵住的時候散開反而通了。
explanation.en: When things are blocked, dispersing can open them.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦沒有這樣說，重點在能不能再聚。
explanation.en: The hexagram says no such thing; the point is whether regathering is possible.

prompt.zh-Hant: 渙的實線在哪三爻？
prompt.en: Which three lines of Huan are solid?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。下卦坎的實線在第二爻，上卦巽的實線在第五與第六爻。
explanation.en: Correct. The lower Kan is solid at the second line and the upper Xun at the fifth and sixth.

explanation.zh-Hant: 初爻與第三爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The first and third lines are broken.

explanation.zh-Hant: 第四爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The fourth line is broken.

summary.zh-Hant: 上坎下兌：澤在下、水在上，有邊界才裝得住。
summary.en: Kan above, Dui below: water over a lake — it holds because there is a boundary.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出節的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Jie (Limitation).

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼限制在這裡是正面的。
objectives.en: Explain why limitation is positive here.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，節會變成困。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns Limitation into Confinement.

structure.zh-Hant: 節的下卦是兌：初爻與第二爻實線、第三爻斷線。上卦是坎：第四爻斷線、第五爻實線、第六爻斷線。整卦第一、第二、第五爻是實線。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Jie is Dui: two solid lines with a broken third. The upper is Kan: broken, solid, broken. The first, second and fifth lines are solid.

plain.zh-Hant: 兌是澤，澤之所以是澤，是因為有岸。水再多，沒有邊界就不叫澤。這一卦談的是節制：限制不是減少，是讓東西留得住。節的難處在量——太鬆裝不住，太緊也裝不住，所以傳統在這一卦特別強調「甘節」而不是硬節。
plain.en: Dui is a lake, and a lake is a lake because it has banks. However much water there is, without a boundary it is not a lake. This hexagram concerns restraint: a limit is not a reduction but what lets something be kept. The difficulty is in the amount — too loose and it does not hold, too tight and it does not either, which is why tradition stresses a limitation one can live with rather than a harsh one.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個團隊規定每次最多三個進行中的工作，不是為了少做，是為了做得完。節描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a team caps work in progress at three items, not to do less but to finish what it starts. Jie describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：坎移到下面、兌移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Kan moves down and Dui moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼說節的限制是正面的？
prompt.en: Why is the limitation in Jie positive?

text.en: A boundary is what lets something be kept

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。兌是澤，澤靠岸才成立。
explanation.en: Correct. Dui is a lake, and a lake exists because of its banks.

text.en: Because a limit means doing less

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦講的是留得住，不是減少。
explanation.en: The hexagram is about holding, not reducing.

explanation.zh-Hant: 太緊也裝不住，量才是難處。
explanation.en: Too tight does not hold either; the amount is the difficulty.

prompt.zh-Hant: 節的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Jie?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻斷、第五爻實、第六爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Broken, solid, broken from the fourth line up.

text.en: Dui (two solid below, one broken on top)

explanation.zh-Hant: 兌在節裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Jie, Dui is the lower trigram.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 節的第六爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The sixth line of Jie is broken.

prompt.zh-Hant: 節的難處在哪裡？
prompt.en: Where is the difficulty in Jie?

text.zh-Hant: 在量：太鬆或太緊都裝不住
text.en: In the amount: too loose or too tight both fail

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。所以傳統強調能維持得下去的節制。
explanation.en: Correct. That is why tradition stresses a limitation one can sustain.

text.en: In having no limit at all

explanation.zh-Hant: 那正是卦要處理的對象。
explanation.en: That is precisely what the hexagram addresses.

text.en: In there being too much water

explanation.zh-Hant: 水多不是問題，沒有岸才是。
explanation.en: Plenty of water is not the problem; having no banks is.

summary.zh-Hant: 上巽下兌：四條實線在外、兩條斷線在中間，裡面是空的。
summary.en: Xun above, Dui below: four solid lines outside and two broken within — hollow at the core.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出中孚的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Zhong Fu.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼「中間空」讀成誠。
objectives.en: Explain why a hollow centre reads as inner truth.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出中孚的上下卦交換之後是大過。
objectives.en: Work out that Inner Truth with its halves swapped is Great Exceeding.

structure.zh-Hant: 中孚的下卦是兌：初爻與第二爻實線、第三爻斷線。上卦是巽：第四爻斷線、第五與第六爻實線。整卦第三與第四爻是斷線，其餘四爻是實線——斷線正好在中間那兩格。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Zhong Fu is Dui: two solid lines with a broken third. The upper is Xun: a broken fourth line with two solid above. The third and fourth lines are broken and the other four are solid, so the broken lines sit exactly at the centre.

plain.zh-Hant: 中間兩爻是空的，外面四爻是實的。空在中間被讀成「虛心」：沒有先塞滿自己的成見，話才進得來。誠不是態度好，而是結構上留了空位。它和大過是一組對照——大過中實兩端虛，中孚中虛四周實；把中孚的上下卦交換就會得到大過，而六爻全部翻面得到的是小過。
plain.en: The two central lines are empty and the four outer ones solid. Emptiness at the centre is read as an open mind: nothing has been packed in first, so what is said can get in. Sincerity here is not good manners but a structural vacancy. Zhong Fu and Da Guo form a contrast — Da Guo is full in the middle and thin at the ends, Zhong Fu hollow in the middle and solid around. Swapping the halves of Zhong Fu gives Da Guo; flipping all six lines gives Xiao Guo instead.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一場檢討會，主持人先不講結論，讓每個人把看到的講完。中孚描述的是這種留空位的結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: at a review meeting the facilitator withholds any conclusion and lets everyone finish describing what they saw. Zhong Fu describes that structure of leaving room.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：巽移到下面、兌移到上面，看看中間兩爻怎麼變。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Xun moves down and Dui moves up, and watch the two central lines change.

prompt.zh-Hant: 中孚的斷線在哪兩爻？
prompt.en: Which two lines of Zhong Fu are broken?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。斷線正好在中間那兩格。
explanation.en: Correct. The broken lines sit exactly at the centre.

explanation.zh-Hant: 斷線在兩端的是大過。
explanation.en: Broken lines at both ends would be Da Guo.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻是實線。
explanation.en: Those two lines are solid.

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個操作會把中孚變成大過？
prompt.en: Which operation turns Zhong Fu into Da Guo?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。中孚下兌上巽；交換成下巽上兌之後，六爻由下而上是斷、實、實、實、實、斷，正是大過。
explanation.en: Correct. Zhong Fu is Dui below and Xun above; swap them to Xun below and Dui above and the six lines read broken, solid, solid, solid, solid, broken from the bottom — Da Guo.

explanation.zh-Hant: 六爻全部翻面會把中間兩爻變實、外面四爻變斷，得到的是小過，不是大過。
explanation.en: Flipping all six makes the two central lines solid and the four outer ones broken: that is Xiao Guo, not Da Guo.

text.en: Turn the whole figure upside down

explanation.zh-Hant: 中孚的六爻排列本來就對稱，上下顛倒之後還是中孚。
explanation.en: The six lines of Zhong Fu are already symmetrical, so turning it upside down leaves Zhong Fu unchanged.

prompt.zh-Hant: 「中虛」為什麼讀成誠？
prompt.en: Why does a hollow centre read as sincerity?

text.zh-Hant: 沒有先塞滿成見，話才進得來
text.en: Nothing was packed in first, so what is said can get in

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。這裡的誠指的是結構上留了空位，不是形容人的性格。
explanation.en: Correct. Sincerity here names a vacancy in the structure, not a description of someone's character.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦講的是結構，不是態度。
explanation.en: The hexagram speaks of structure, not manners.

text.en: Because the two central lines are solid

explanation.zh-Hant: 中間兩爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The two central lines are broken.

summary.zh-Hant: 上震下艮：止在下、動在上，只能小幅超出的結構。
summary.en: Zhen above, Gen below: stopping underneath, movement above — only a small exceeding.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出小過的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Xiao Guo.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出小過和大過的差別。
objectives.en: State how Xiao Guo differs from Da Guo.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出小過與頤用的是同樣兩個三爻卦，只差位置。
objectives.en: Point out that Small Exceeding and Nourishing use the same two trigrams in the other order.

structure.zh-Hant: 小過的下卦是艮：初爻與第二爻斷線、第三爻實線。上卦是震：第四爻實線、第五與第六爻斷線。整卦只有第三與第四爻是實線，其餘四爻是斷線——兩條實線剛好在中間那兩格。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Xiao Guo is Gen: two broken lines with a solid third. The upper is Zhen: a solid fourth line with two broken above. Only the third and fourth lines are solid and the other four are broken, so the solid lines sit exactly at the centre.

plain.zh-Hant: 大過是中間四爻全實，份量壓在中段；小過只有中間兩爻是實的，份量輕得多。所以同樣是「超出」，小過超出的幅度很小。這一卦讀成只宜小事：結構撐不起大動作，硬要做大就不是超出一點，而是整個垮掉。
plain.en: In Da Guo the four central lines are solid and the weight presses on the middle; in Xiao Guo only two central lines are solid and the weight is far lighter. So although both speak of exceeding, Xiao Guo exceeds only slightly. It reads as suited to small matters: the structure cannot carry a large move, and forcing one would not be exceeding a little but collapsing altogether.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個人力很薄的團隊可以多接一個小案子，但不能接一個大案子。小過描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a thinly staffed team can take on one more small job but not a large one. Xiao Guo describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：震移到下面、艮移到上面，看看那兩條實線跑到第幾爻。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Zhen moves down and Gen moves up, and see where the two solid lines land.

explanation.zh-Hant: 那兩爻是斷線。

explanation.en: Correct. The weight differs greatly, and so does how far each exceeds.

prompt.zh-Hant: 小過說的是什麼？
prompt.en: What does Xiao Guo say?

text.zh-Hant: 結構只撐得起小幅度的超出

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。硬要做大就不是超出一點。
explanation.en: Correct. Forcing a large move would not be exceeding a little.

explanation.zh-Hant: 小事可以，卦沒有說全部不行。

summary.zh-Hant: 上坎下離：六爻陰陽完全交錯，每一爻都在它該在的位置。
summary.en: Kan above, Li below: the six lines alternate perfectly, each in its proper place.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出既濟的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Ji Ji.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出為什麼「完全整齊」反而要提醒。
objectives.en: Explain why perfect order carries a caution.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出把上下卦交換之後，既濟會變成未濟。
objectives.en: Say that swapping the halves turns After Completion into Before Completion.

structure.zh-Hant: 既濟的下卦是離：初爻實線、第二爻斷線、第三爻實線。上卦是坎：第四爻斷線、第五爻實線、第六爻斷線。整卦從下往上是實、斷、實、斷、實、斷，陰陽完全交錯，奇數位全是陽、偶數位全是陰。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Ji Ji is Li: solid, broken, solid. The upper is Kan: broken, solid, broken. From the bottom up the figure runs solid, broken, solid, broken, solid, broken — a perfect alternation, with yang in every odd place and yin in every even one.

plain.zh-Hant: 六十四卦裡只有兩卦是完全交錯的，既濟是其中一個。每一爻都在傳統認為「該在」的位置，所以叫既濟——已經完成。提醒也正是從這裡來：完成了就沒有往前的餘地，下一步只可能是鬆動。這一卦談的不是慶賀，而是維持。
plain.en: Only two of the sixty-four hexagrams alternate perfectly, and Ji Ji is one of them. Every line sits where tradition holds it ought to, hence the name: already across. The caution comes from exactly that — once complete, there is no room to advance, and the next step can only be a loosening. This hexagram is about maintenance, not celebration.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個系統剛好所有指標都達標，接下來的工作是維持而不是衝刺。既濟描述的是這種結構。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a system has just met every target, and the work ahead is maintenance rather than another sprint. Ji Ji describes that structure.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換：坎移到下面、離移到上面，看看卦名變成什麼。
instruction.en: Swap the halves so Kan moves down and Li moves up, and see what the name becomes.

prompt.zh-Hant: 既濟的陰陽排列有什麼特別？

text.en: The six lines alternate perfectly: yang in odd places, yin in even

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。六十四卦裡只有兩卦這樣排。
explanation.en: Correct. Only two of the sixty-four are arranged this way.

explanation.zh-Hant: 六爻全陽是乾。

explanation.zh-Hant: 既濟的上下卦是坎與離，不相同。

prompt.zh-Hant: 為什麼完全整齊反而要提醒？
prompt.en: Why does perfect order carry a caution?

text.zh-Hant: 完成了就沒有往前的餘地，下一步只能是鬆動
text.en: Once complete there is no room to advance; the next step can only loosen

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。所以這一卦談維持，不談慶賀。
explanation.en: Correct. Hence this hexagram is about maintenance, not celebration.

explanation.zh-Hant: 卦沒有這樣說，它說的是位置已經用完。

text.zh-Hant: 因為卦裡有坎就一定有險

explanation.zh-Hant: 提醒來自排列已滿，不是單一個三爻卦。
explanation.en: The caution comes from the arrangement being full, not from one trigram.

prompt.zh-Hant: 既濟的上卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the upper half of Ji Ji?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。第四爻斷、第五爻實、第六爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Broken, solid, broken from the fourth line up.

explanation.zh-Hant: 離在既濟裡是下卦。
explanation.en: In Ji Ji, Li is the lower trigram.

text.en: Xun (one broken below, two solid above)

explanation.zh-Hant: 既濟的第六爻是斷線。
explanation.en: The sixth line of Ji Ji is broken.

summary.zh-Hant: 上離下坎：同樣完全交錯，但每一爻都在相反的位置。
summary.en: Li above, Kan below: the same perfect alternation, with every line in the opposite place.

objectives.zh-Hant: 指出未濟的上卦與下卦各是什麼。
objectives.en: Name the upper and lower trigram of Wei Ji.

objectives.zh-Hant: 說出未濟與既濟的關係。
objectives.en: State how Wei Ji relates to Ji Ji.

objectives.zh-Hant: 算出未濟的上下卦交換之後是既濟。
objectives.en: Work out that Before Completion with its halves swapped is After Completion.

structure.zh-Hant: 未濟的下卦是坎：初爻斷線、第二爻實線、第三爻斷線。上卦是離：第四爻實線、第五爻斷線、第六爻實線。整卦從下往上是斷、實、斷、實、斷、實，和既濟逐爻相反，也是上下卦互換的結果。
structure.en: The lower trigram of Wei Ji is Kan: broken, solid, broken. The upper is Li: solid, broken, solid. From the bottom up the figure runs broken, solid, broken, solid, broken, solid — the line-by-line opposite of Ji Ji, and also the result of exchanging its halves.

plain.zh-Hant: 六十四卦以未濟結尾，而不是以既濟結尾。這件事本身就是一個說法：排列最整齊的那一卦不是最後一卦，最後一卦是「還沒完成」。它的結構同樣完全交錯，只是每一爻都落在相反的位置——條件齊備，位置還沒對上，所以事情還在進行。
plain.en: The sixty-four hexagrams end with Wei Ji, not with Ji Ji. That ordering is itself a statement: the most orderly figure is not the last one; the last one is “not yet across”. Its structure alternates just as perfectly, only every line falls in the opposite place — the elements are all present and not yet matched to their positions, so the thing is still under way.

example.zh-Hant: 教學示例，不是結果預測：一個專案所有條件都備齊，只是還沒排進時程。未濟描述的是這種還沒完成的結構，不是說它不會完成。
example.en: A teaching example, not a prediction: a project has everything it needs and has simply not been scheduled yet. Wei Ji describes that unfinished structure; it does not say it stays unfinished.

instruction.zh-Hant: 把上下卦交換，看看會回到哪一卦。這一組是六十四卦的最後兩卦。
instruction.en: Swap the halves and see which hexagram you return to. This pair closes the sixty-four.

prompt.zh-Hant: 未濟和既濟的關係是什麼？

explanation.zh-Hant: 六爻全部相反，不是一爻。

prompt.zh-Hant: 六十四卦以未濟結尾，這件事說明什麼？

text.zh-Hant: 最後一卦是「還沒完成」，不是最整齊的那一卦

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。這個排序本身就是一個說法。
explanation.en: Correct. The ordering is itself a statement.

prompt.zh-Hant: 未濟的下卦是哪一個三爻卦？
prompt.en: Which trigram is the lower half of Wei Ji?

explanation.zh-Hant: 對。初爻斷、第二爻實、第三爻斷。
explanation.en: Correct. Broken, solid, broken from the bottom.

explanation.zh-Hant: 離在未濟裡是上卦。
explanation.en: In Wei Ji, Li is the upper trigram.

explanation.zh-Hant: 未濟的第二爻是實線。
explanation.en: The second line of Wei Ji is solid.
